cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: E2f4 perturbation most strongly derepressed a one-sided mitotic, kinetochore, spindle, and DNA-repair transcript program in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, where 32 FDR-significant genes were all upregulated, including Aaas, Rad18, Tacc3, Tube1, Cenpw, Blm, Ncapd2, Polq, Ddx11, and Dsn1. This pattern is consistent with partial relief of E2F4/DREAM cell-cycle repression, but it appeared uncoupled from canonical G1/S E2F targets and diverged from E2f1, E2f5, Tfdp1, and Rb1 signatures. Only transcript abundance was measured, so these postmitotic cell-cycle-like inductions were not validated as cell-cycle entry or cell death.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Mga perturbation produced a sparse ectopic response rather than a broad transcriptional hit, with upregulation centered on the meiotic cohesin gene Stag3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Obscn and near-threshold Tasor also increased, and Max converged on Stag3 and Obscn; in 155 MB Glut, Stag3 reached significance after both Mga and Max perturbation despite no detectable Mga mRNA knockdown or global Max/Mga signature correlation. This direction is consistent with MAX/MGA-ncPRC1.6 repression of ectopic germline or meiotic genes, but only Stag3 was significant in both classes and a broader meiotic program was not detected.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Pik3ca showed a weak transcriptomic response overall, but in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, Pten was the clearest antagonist signature neighbor: among 2,045 same-cell-type perturbations, Pten was the most anti-correlated to Pik3ca by Wilcoxon-score correlation. This direction is consistent with PTEN opposing class IA PI3K/PIP3-AKT signaling, whereas other PI3K-subunit comparators such as Pik3cb, Pik3r1, and Pik3r2 were near zero. The effect should be interpreted cautiously because the absolute correlation was small and is mainly informative by rank within this cell type.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Apc perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut activated a canonical Wnt/β-catenin feedback program that was opposed by Ctnnb1 loss in the same class: Axin2 and Notum increased with Apc perturbation but decreased with Ctnnb1, and 79 of 92 overlapping corrected genes showed opposite signs. This reciprocal pattern matches the expected APC–β-catenin pathway topology and supports Axin2 and Notum as directional Wnt readouts here, although the strongest quantified anti-correlation was limited to the 303 Apc-significant genes and not every Apc-responsive gene was a corrected Ctnnb1 hit.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Actn4 diverged from nearby actin cytoskeleton and adhesion perturbations in this Perturb-seq dataset. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Actg1, Ctnnb1, and Cdc42 showed strong target-RNA knockdown, whereas Actn4 did not, and in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, the nominal Actn4 L4/5 signature was nearly uncorrelated with Actg1, Cdc42, and Itgb1. Thus, despite ACTN4 being in the same network, Actn4 appeared buffered relative to network neighbors, with only a nominal cytoskeletal tail, no FDR-significant genes, and conclusions limited to transcriptomic comparisons of the top 200 nominal Actn4 L4/5 genes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chd8 perturbation did not produce a signature interchangeable with several direct CHD8 interactors or chromatin-disease neighbors across 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA cells. Using the top 200 Chd8-ranked genes, Ctnnb1, Chd7, Ctcf, Setd1a, Chd4, Smarce1, and Kansl1 were weakly correlated or anticorrelated with Chd8, while Yy1 and Ppp2r1a were only modest positive neighbors. This suggests that network or physical proximity in the CHD8 chromatin-regulator pathway did not reliably predict perturbation similarity, although some comparator knockdowns showed weak target-transcript engagement, limiting definitive interpretation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Smc3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a weak but interpretable cohesin-like signature: its closest positive neighbors across perturbations were Nipbl, Smc1a, and Stag2, consistent with convergence in cohesin loading and genome-folding pathways. Although Smc3 itself had no FDR-significant genes and correlations were modest, it shared same-direction nominal downshifts in neuronal calcium and synaptic genes, including Atp2a2, Grin2c, Pcp4, Necab2, Ptprm, Ramp3, and Ache, which were more strongly affected by Nipbl, Smc1a, or Stag2.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Pogz showed a divergent Perturb-seq signature, with responses nearly orthogonal to Adnp, Chd4, and Chd8 despite their shared POGZ-ADNP/CHD4 chromatin-regulatory interaction neighborhood. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where Adnp, Chd4, and Chd8 produced many FDR-significant effects, Pogz had only weak nominal differential expression and did not phenocopy these related chromatin regulators. This contrast is tempered by weak Pogz transcript knockdown and weak downstream differential expression, so the result supports lack of phenocopying rather than an opposite mechanism.

Asah1 showed no strong convergence or opposition with related perturbations in these acute neuronal signatures: whole-signature correlations with Smpd3, Sphk1, Lamp2, and Atp6v1a were nearly absent, and the top positive and negative Asah1 neighbors across the library were also weak. This argues against treating Asah1 as transcriptionally interchangeable with a generic lysosome perturbation or with the tested sphingolipid-pathway neighbors, although the inference is limited because the Asah1 signatures themselves were weak and the available comparators sample only part of the lysosome and sphingolipid space.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Apc perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells intersected a thalamic glutamatergic differentiation and excitability-associated marker program that also responded to Tcf7l2, but mostly in the opposite direction. The Apc signature altered Cck, Spock3, Nexn and repressed neuronal markers including Grin2c, Grin2d, Gls, and Chgb, alongside Wnt feedback induction, suggesting APC/Wnt activation distorts a TCF7L2-related identity program rather than simply phenocopying Tcf7l2 loss. This overlap was limited to 29 corrected genes, with 27 opposing directions, so the relationship may be indirect and stage-dependent.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Ankrd12 showed its clearest FDR-corrected self-knockdown in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, yet the expected p160/nuclear-receptor coactivator axis was not a dominant shared signature: Ncoa1 and Ncoa3 were essentially uncorrelated with Ankrd12, Rora and other screened neighbors also failed to converge, and even the top positive and negative genome-scale neighbors were weak (|r|<0.09). In 155 MB Glut, Ankrd12 remained weak and diverged from stronger Ankrd11-related midbrain signatures, with U2surp the only non-target FDR hit. This transcriptomic comparison is limited because the Ankrd12 signature was sparse and many physical complex members were not screened or not target-engaged.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Sp7 showed its only multiple-testing-significant response in 308 CB GABA neurons, where a weak nominal tail was directionally aligned with Msx2 in the same cell class. Across 260 Sp7-nominal genes, Sp7 and Msx2 scores were positively correlated, and Msx2 was among the top positive neighbors in the restricted 308 CB GABA scan, suggesting an exploratory link within a RUNX2/MSX2/SP7 osteoblast-differentiation context. However, canonical markers such as Runx2, Dlx5, Col1a1, Col1a2, Alpl, Spp1, and Ibsp were unchanged, and most overlapping genes were not FDR-significant, so this remains a nominal, cell-type-mismatched follow-up hypothesis.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Vezf1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a thalamic signature that was not recapitulated by Ctcf or Dnmt3a perturbation, with near-zero correlation to the top 200 Vezf1-scored genes, whereas Zbtb7a showed only a modest inverse restricted relationship that included opposite directions for Prkcg and Tle2. This suggests Vezf1 output is not equivalent to generic CTCF-barrier or de novo DNA-methylation loss in this context, although the Zbtb7a contrast is exploratory because it was computed only on the restricted top-200 gene set and does not establish direct regulation.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Fto in 155 MB Glut showed a restricted, modest signature that was most similar to the spliceosome perturbations Prpf6 and Ddx23 and opposite to Fus when analysis was limited to the top 100 absolute Fto genes. In this midbrain glutamatergic class, Rsrp1 decreased strongly and tracked the same or opposite direction across these comparator perturbations, with additional nominal RNA-processing-associated neighbors including Dazap1, Rnpc3, and Atp11b. These patterns are consistent with an RNA-processing module readout in 155 MB Glut, but correlations were modest and no direct FTO-RSRP1 biochemical link was measured.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Sod2 showed no close positive or negative genome-wide signature neighbor in the four engaged neuronal cell types—151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—and its transcriptomic profile was nearly uncorrelated with available antioxidant or oxidative-phosphorylation perturbations, including Gpx4, Prdx1, Nfe2l2, Sdha, Cox4i1, and Ndufs1. Although SOD2 is placed in mitochondrial superoxide detoxification and ROS detoxification pathways, the measured CRISPRi phenotype was not interchangeable with those comparators, and several comparator perturbations had weak or unmeasured on-target RNA depletion, so the main conclusion is lack of observed convergence rather than mechanistic opposition.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Hnrnpc showed its strongest signature in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons as a mixed RNA-splicing and nuclear-speck module, with increased Ddx39b, Ddx17, Srsf11, Pnn, and Ncbp1 alongside decreased Rbm25, Luc7l2, Srsf2, Tia1, and Rbm5. This recurrent mixed-direction pattern also appeared in 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut cells, linking the abundance signature to the HNRNPC splice-regulatory axis while noting that the assay measures transcript abundance rather than exon inclusion, so downstream splicing events are not directly observed.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ntrk2 loss in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic cells produced the strongest non-target FDR response, with Atp2a2 and Vgf decreased, and its whole-transcriptome signature was weakly opposite to Nf1 and Pten perturbation signatures, with Gsk3b also considered among pathway-neighbor comparators. This direction is consistent with BDNF/NTF4-NTRK2 signaling acting upstream of RAS/PI3K while NF1 and PTEN oppose those arms, but the anti-correlations were small in magnitude and reflect mRNA-level signatures rather than direct biochemical pathway activity assays.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Msl2 showed a weak, uncoupled perturbation signature in adult brain cells: across 20 cell types, including 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 054 CNU-MGE GABA, and 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, Msl2 had no FDR-significant hits, while Kansl1, Trrap, and Chd8 were robustly active under the same differential-expression workflow and their genome-wide score vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Msl2. Because Msl1, Msl3, and Kat8 were not assayed, this contrast is limited to available HAT/chromatin neighbors rather than the full core MSL complex.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kdm6a in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a weak but coherent neuronal signature that converged with Kmt2d in the same direction, led by Ntng1 and including Nell1, Ptpn5, Cyp46a1, Tspan33, Thy1, and Mical2. In this adult thalamic glutamatergic class, Ntng1 was the strongest FDR-supported Kdm6a response, while the broader convergence came from correlation of the restricted top-500 Kdm6a signature with Kmt2d, not with Kdm6b or Kmt2c. This supports a cell-type-specific KDM6A–MLL4/ASCOM-related module, with the caveat that only Ntng1 passed FDR and no direct chromatin measurements were made.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Nsd2 diverged from related H3K36 histone methylation perturbations: although grouped with Nsd1, Ash1l, and Setd2 in the same pathway, Nsd2 showed no FDR-level genes and near-zero signature correlations with those comparators. This was most evident in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, where Nsd1, Ash1l, and Setd2 had detectable responses while Nsd2 had none despite 141 perturbed cells, and similarly in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, where Nsd1 had one FDR gene but Nsd2 had none. The divergence may reflect weaker Nsd2 target engagement rather than a proven mechanistic separation among H3K36 enzymes.

Foxc1 showed no strong convergence or opposition with related perturbations or genome-wide signature neighbors. Foxc2, the closest assayed paralog, along with Pitx2, Cxcr4, and BMP-receptor perturbations such as Bmpr2 and Bmpr1b, did not reveal a hidden Foxc1-like axis, and the strongest all-target Foxc1 score correlations were only about |r|=0.22. These results argue against a large shared FOXC1 transcriptional program or coupling to mesenchymal CXCL12-CXCR4/BMP-associated developmental signaling, although the Foxc1 vector itself was weak, so subtle cis-regulatory similarity cannot be excluded.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Phf21a in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a distinctive HDAC1/2-associated chromatin-repressor complex specificity: Phf21a targeting increased Rreb1, whereas Sin3a targeting in the same thalamic subclass decreased Rreb1, indicating opposing Rreb1 directions despite shared HDAC1/2-associated biology. This argues that HDAC-core perturbations are not directionally interchangeable. The contrast is centered on the shared output gene Rreb1, and Sin3a produced a much broader transcriptional signature than Phf21a in this cell type.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut
full_finding_text: Lrp4 perturbation did not yield an FDR-supported SOST/Wnt-beta-catenin or APP-related transcriptional response in the neuronal dataset. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Axin2 showed only a nominal increase, while App showed no corrected change; similarly, across 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 145 MH-LH TH Glut, no FDR-supported direction was detected for Wnt readouts. Given that only a few transcript readouts were examined, this should be interpreted as absence of detectable pathway output here, not evidence for opposite Wnt regulation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ppp3r1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed its clearest non-target relationship with an AP-2/clathrin-adaptor endocytic signature: Ap2s1 and Ap2m1 were the strongest anti-correlated perturbation neighbors and reversed several Ppp3r1-regulated genes, with Pten also among the opposing comparators. This pattern suggests an antagonistic transcriptional relationship between PPP3R1-dependent calcium phosphatase signaling and AP-2 adaptor perturbation in this cell type, but the correlations were modest, arose from exploratory signature comparison rather than a prespecified pathway test, and the dataset did not directly measure vesicle endocytosis.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Uba5 showed its strongest convergence with the UFMylation E2 gene Ufc1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, where Ufc1 phenocopied the dominant Uba5 response with on-target depletion, 495 shared FDR<0.05 genes, and highly correlated Wilcoxon scores across Uba5-significant genes (r=0.881). This same-direction overlap anchors the large 151-cell-class signature to the protein ufmylation cascade, alongside OXPHOS/V-ATPase remodeling and partial ER-stress output involving genes such as Eef1a1, Rsrp1, Atp6v0c, and Ddit3. The strongest quantified convergence was confined to this class, as Ufc1 was weaker or poorly target-engaged in several other Uba5-responsive classes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Nrf1 perturbation in the strongest responsive mouse-brain classes—151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—did not phenocopy nearby mitochondrial-transcription regulators. In these cell types, Yy1 was weakly anticorrelated or orthogonal to Nrf1, and perturbations of the PGC/ERR/NFE2L-axis genes Nfe2l1, Nfe2l2, Ppargc1a, Ppargc1b, Esrra, as well as Mtor and Rptor, were near-zero correlated with the Nrf1 signature. This argues that the Nrf1 state is not interchangeable with these regulators in these classes, although different guide cell counts and target-transcript behavior mean transcriptome-level divergence does not exclude convergence on respiration.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ank3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells showed weak same-direction signature similarity to Scn8a, Scn1b, and Fgf14, which were high-ranking neighbors within an ankyrin-G/AIS sodium-channel scaffold context. This pattern suggests exploratory convergence with the expected AIS molecular neighborhood, but the full-signature Pearson correlations were small, Scn8a reached only self-level FDR significance, and the data do not support treating these perturbations as interchangeable or concluding that sodium-channel loss alone explains the Ank3 signature.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Thap11 showed its closest positive restricted-signature neighbor as Ogt on a 20-gene recurrent core, with partial same-direction overlap driven mainly by the down-regulated arm in 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. This convergence included core genes such as Sdccag8, Rabac1, Acp6, Tcea2, Cdk5, Mdh1, and Gdap1, and is consistent with an indirect HCF-1/O-GlcNAc chromatin axis. However, the scan was limited to 20 recurrent genes, Ogt did not reproduce the full Thap11 signature, and no strong anti-correlated perturbation was detected.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Dstyk in 308 CB GABA showed an unexpected signature structure: its suggestive cerebellar response was embedded in a stronger Wdr26-like axis and opposed by Ranbp2, rather than aligning most strongly with FGF receptors or MAPK components. Wdr26 was the top positive genome-wide neighbor and Ranbp2 the top negative neighbor, with Wdr26 matching the signs of all top 20 Dstyk genes and Ranbp2 opposing 15 of 20. This contrast was evident across a cerebellar GABA synaptic and calcium-channel module including Grin2d, Dtna, Dach1, Ryr2, Trpc3, Hcn2, Nptx1, Homer1, Homer3, Grm1, and Grid2, but these are dataset signature neighbors, not demonstrated DSTYK physical interactors or pathway members.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Samd12 showed a cerebellar GABAergic-specific, exploratory overlap with Stard7 in 308 CB GABA cells: 53 genes were shared at nominal p<0.05 versus 20.4 expected, and all changed in the same direction. This modest convergent signature was enriched for synaptic-membrane annotations and included genes such as Gabra1, Gabrb2, Grm1, Grid2, Snap25, Pvalb, Kcnc3, Cacna1d, and Nrg1. However, neither Samd12 nor Stard7 reached FDR significance in this cell type, so the result is best treated as a follow-up hypothesis rather than a validated module.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ankrd11 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells produced a restricted top-300-gene signature that converged with Setd5, was near-zero for Ankrd12, Ep300, and Crebbp, and was inverted for Med23 and Wdr26. The responsive program included an induced chromatin-regulated synaptic receptor/channel and RGS module with genes such as Grin2b, Grm1, Gabbr2, Lrrc7, Kcnc2, Kcnq2, Rgs4, Prkcd, Ntng1, and Adarb1. This similarity is limited to one cell class and does not establish a direct ANKRD11-SETD5 complex.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Dync1h1 showed positive restricted-signature similarity to Rab7 and ESCRT/late-endosomal perturbations, including Vps37a, Snf8, and the dynactin component Dctn1, in responsive sterol states across 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA neurons. The convergence was strongest in 155 MB Glut, where Dync1h1 loss produced the largest sterol induction and an opposite direction to Srebf2 knockdown, while 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed only nominal sterol movement despite close Dctn1 and Rab7 signatures. This pattern links dynein-dynactin retrograde transport to endosome-lysosome trafficking, but it is based on top-500 signature correlations rather than direct physical or cholesterol-trafficking assays.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tbce in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells showed that the strongest unbiased 151-cell signature neighbors were not good substitutes for tubulin biology. Although Atp6v0c was the top positive global neighbor, it downregulated Tuba1a, opposite to the Tbce-associated direction, while Wdfy3, the top negative neighbor, did not significantly affect Tuba1a or Tubb5. Thus, in the only cell class with a multi-gene FDR-significant Tbce signature, global perturbation correlation did not imply matched tubulin-homeostasis biology, and no direct Atp6v0c–Tbce relationship was established.

Rnpc3 was not directly perturbed in this screen, so inference comes from a restricted 14-feature Rnpc3 module rather than full-transcriptome or subunit-level comparisons. Within that limited signature-neighbor analysis, the Rnpc3-like state converged with Srsf1, Prpf6, Ddx23, and U2af2, but opposed Cdk13, Trrap, Ppp2r1a, and Yy1. These patterns suggest context-specific crosstalk between RNA processing and major/minor spliceosome-associated programs, rather than a generic RNA-processing readout, while leaving subunit rescue, epistasis, and direct complex-member conclusions unresolved.

Ccser1 did not recapitulate a robust brain perturbation signature matching published FAM190A/circFam190a interactor biology. In the assayed dataset, the nearest comparisons to the AKT1/HSP90β osteoclastogenesis axis and the FAM190A mitotic/STRING interactor neighborhood were weak, exploratory, and directionally inconsistent: Hsp90ab1, Wwox, and Grid2 showed only modest restricted-signature similarity, sometimes alongside negative-control targets. This pattern varied by cell class, with a weak positive Wwox correlation in 046 CTX-CGE GABA but an opposite Wwox signature in 308 CB GABA, and several key comparators, including Akt1, Ndel1, Nde1, Mapre1, and Exoc1, were not assayed.

Plpbp showed no convergent transcriptomic signature neighbor in this assay: across 2,045 other perturbations, pooled correlations with Plpbp were essentially zero, from -0.032 to +0.029, and the strongest cell-type-specific absolute correlation reached only 0.149. This means no same-assay perturbation provides a confident phenocopy or rescue-direction comparator for Plpbp. Interpretation is limited because correlation was computed on Wilcoxon-score vectors and the Plpbp signature was weak, reducing power to detect similarity; moreover, informative PLP-related genes Pdxk, Pnpo, Pdxp, and Aldh7a1 were not perturbed in the library.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Bptf showed a restricted signature that opposed Chd4 rather than matching a generic chromatin-remodeler response, most clearly in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and also in 155 MB Glut. In these glutamatergic classes, the Bptf-diagnostic pattern included Zcwpw2 and Grk4 induction with Resp18 and Stxbp2 repression, and Chd4 scored as the strongest negative restricted neighbor on these Bptf-significant genes. This contrast supports a BPTF-NURF versus CHD4-NuRD distinction, although many individual Chd4 gene effects were only nominal or not FDR-significant.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tbl1xr1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a weak thalamic signature that only partially overlapped the NCoR/SMRT-HDAC3 and Wnt-beta-catenin cofactor network neighbors Ctnnb1, Tcf7l2, and Tbl1x. The Tbl1xr1 score vector was nearly uncorrelated with Ctnnb1 despite shared down-regulation of Vangl1 and Prkcg, while Rasa4 and Ppard changed in the opposite direction under Ctnnb1 knockdown; Tcf7l2 and Tbl1x were also weak neighbors. Because target-mRNA knockdown was not detected for Tbl1xr1, this weak correlation could reflect limited perturbation engagement rather than true mechanistic independence.

Mcph1 perturbation did not produce a detectable transcriptional program for its canonical pathways in this neuronal Perturb-seq dataset: DNA-damage and homologous-recombination genes such as Atm, Atr, Brca2, Rad51, Mdc1, Rnf168, and Ube2n, as well as Condensin II and chromosome-condensation genes including Ncapd3, Ncapd2, Ncaph2, Smc2, and Smc4, remained FDR-flat, and no assayed cell type showed significant differential expression. This negative result should be interpreted cautiously because MCPH1 checkpoint, repair, and condensin functions are largely post-translational and cell-cycle dependent, making steady-state mRNA an indirect readout.

cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Nrl diverged from active Maf-family bZIP transcription-factor signatures in this dataset: across 001 L5-6 IT Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, and 155 MB Glut, its score vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Maf, Mafa, Mafb, and Mafg. In contrast, Mafg showed corrected on-target responses and a strong Hmox1 response, including in 052 Pvalb Gaba, while Nrl showed no expression-based on-target knockdown in any cell type. These comparisons rely on transcriptome-correlation patterns rather than direct biochemical tests of interchangeability.

Pds5a showed a weak, non-recurrent transcriptional response across profiled brain cell classes, with no robust FDR-significant downstream differential-expression row and no shared cohesin, replication-stress, or Polycomb-like module. Across 106 nominal Pds5a rows, only Exd2 recurred in more than one cell type, while cohesin-accessory or regulatory transcripts including Pds5b, Wapl, Nipbl, Mau2, Smc1a, Hdac8, Esco1, and Esco2 remained non-significant; even in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the expected cohesin-pathway response was not robust. This analysis was based on DE recurrence and measured pathway-member transcripts rather than dedicated chromatin-loop, replication-fork, or Polycomb reporter assays.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tcf7l2, in the responsive thalamic subtype 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, showed a perturbation signature that converged with Ctnnb1 and opposed Apc. Ctnnb1 was the strongest positive neighbor of Tcf7l2, and within the 106 Tcf7l2 FDR-significant genes their correlation was 0.646, with 40 of 44 shared hits changing in the same direction; Apc was anti-correlated on this restricted signature, with 27 of 29 shared hits in the opposite direction. Genome-wide correlations were modest, and classic Wnt feedback markers such as Axin2, Nkd1, and Lef1 responded to Apc or Ctnnb1 more than to Tcf7l2.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Nr1d2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic neurons shows a weak thalamic response that largely recapitulates a subset of the Nr1d1 perturbation program. Nr1d1 is the strongest hit, and shared nonparalog genes such as Cacna2d3, Rasl11b, Grb14, Plekhd1, Erc2, and L1cam suggest a modest REV-ERB-sensitive module. This convergence is positive but limited: several shared genes are only nominal or near-threshold, overall correlation with the Nr1d1 signature is modest, and no clear anti-correlated biological target emerges. In this thalamic context, Nr1d2 perturbation de-represses Nr1d1, whereas Rora shows the opposite signed effect on Nr1d1.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Arid1a in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neuronal state showed a cBAF-core-like signature that related ARID and ATPase perturbations did not simply phenocopy. In this cell type, Arid1b was only the fifth closest positive neighbor, Arid2 was nearly uncorrelated, and Smarca2 was the fourth most negative genome-wide neighbor, while Smarca4 also diverged. This separates canonical BAF base-module convergence from ARID1B substitution, ARID2-pBAF biology, and SMARCA2/4 catalytic-subunit perturbation, although the Smarca2 anticorrelation was weak and Smarca4 target engagement was weak at the transcript level.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Sox3 showed no FDR-significant effects in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, where related Sox-factor perturbations were not interchangeable: Sox2 and Sox5 produced the only FDR-level hits among the assayed Sox/Pax6 comparisons, including opposite regulation of Tnnt1, with Sox2 linked to lower Tnnt1 and Stam and Sox5 to higher Tnnt1 and Dgkh. In contrast, Sox3 left Tnnt1, Stam, and Dgkh non-significant and its overall signature correlated only weakly with Sox2 or Sox5. This contrast is limited to a small number of hits in this single thalamic class, and Sox2/Sox5 target-transcript repression was not itself FDR-confirmed.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Stag2 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons was broadly similar to Nipbl, with shared down-regulation of adhesion and cell-junction genes including Ptprm, Necab2, Smtn, and Adamts2 within a neuronal projection, synapse, and cell junction module, but selected synaptic genes split in direction: Gabra1 and Brinp1 increased after Stag2 while decreasing after Nipbl. This suggests Nipbl is not a simple directional substitute for Stag2 at every synaptic locus, although the split is gene-level and was not validated by protein or chromatin assays.

cell_types: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Abca7 in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut neurons showed a transcriptomic response that was not interchangeable with Abca1 or other assayed Alzheimer-family perturbations: the CA3 Abca7 top-200 signed signature was anticorrelated with Abca1 and Trem2, and nearly orthogonal to App, Bin1, Sorl1, and Mef2c, with strongest restricted neighbors instead among noncanonical targets such as Grid2, Smarcc2, Zbtb21, and Smarca2. This argues against a simple shared AD-risk or ABC-family lipid transport/ApoA1-axis program in this neuronal context, although the comparison is limited to a restricted top-200 nominal-gene signature rather than a genome-wide FDR-significant program.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kdm5b showed a divergent, buffered signature from its assayed paralog Kdm5c, arguing against simple interchangeability in these neuronal classes. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Kdm5c produced an FDR-level program with 18 significant genes, including Ptgds, Capn3, Man2a2, and Zfp532, whereas Kdm5b produced none and its all-gene profile was nearly uncorrelated with Kdm5c (Pearson r=0.035). This paralog contrast is signature-based, however, because Kdm5c target-transcript engagement in this cell type was only nominal rather than FDR-significant.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Baz1b showed FDR-significant target depletion across five engaged cell types—151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—but its RNA signature did not converge strongly in either direction with assayed chromatin-regulator perturbations, including CHD, BAF/PBAF, CREBBP/EP300, HDAC, KAT6, BRD, or VDR factors such as Chd2, Chd4, Chd7, Chd8, Smarca4, Smarcb1, Crebbp, and Ep300. Responses were generally weak, with few non-target genes reaching significance, and key WICH/B-WICH partners like Smarca5, Smarca1, Sf3b1, Ddx21, Dek, Ercc6, Mybbp1a, and Myo1c were not perturbed, so this remains an exploratory non-convergence result.

Foxe3 showed a globally flat perturbation signature across the 23 assayed brain cell classes, with no adjusted-significant downstream genes and a flat target transcript where measured. This matched the broader pattern for assayed Fox-family DNA-binding transcription-factor perturbations: 13 of the 14 other Fox targets, including Foxa2, Foxc1, Foxc2, Foxi1, Foxj1, Foxj3, Foxk2, Foxl1, Foxl2, Foxn1, Foxp1, Foxp2, and Foxp3, also had zero adjusted-significant genes, while Foxg1 had only one. A same-family scan therefore did not reveal a robust Foxe3-like, opposite, or compensatory forkhead signature, although this family-name comparison is limited because Fox proteins are not interchangeable paralogs and may be expressed in different cell states.

Hnrnpdl diverged from the stronger hnRNP perturbations rather than phenocopying them in this mouse-brain total-RNA readout. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the only cell type with an FDR-significant Hnrnpdl response, the effect was modest and included a selective increase in Hnrnpu, whereas Hnrnpu and Hnrnpc perturbations in the same class produced many more FDR hits (733 and 122, respectively). Across assayed hnRNPs, Hnrnpdl score vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Hnrnpa1, Hnrnpa2b1, Hnrnpc, Hnrnph2, and Hnrnpu, though this comparison is based on score correlations and FDR burden rather than matched protein depletion.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Sox9 showed a divergent Sox-family transcription-factor response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons: unlike Sox2 and Sox5, which produced corrected thalamic signatures and FDR-significant effects including opposite changes in Tnnt1, Sox9 did not affect Tnnt1, Stam, or Dgkh there. Across available Sox-family perturbations, Sox9 had no strong positive or negative transcriptomic neighbor and whole-signature correlations were near zero, suggesting Sox-family membership did not predict interchangeability in this neuronal context, though these guide-set transcriptomic comparisons do not establish protein-level redundancy or antagonism.

cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Nr2f2 did not show a simple paralog or complex-member phenocopy pattern in the restricted brain signatures: in glutamatergic 001 L5-6 IT Glut and 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut, Nr2c2 was the clearest anti-correlated comparator, whereas Nr2f1 and Nr2f6 did not converge with the Nr2f2 score vector. This opposition is biologically suggestive given the curated NR2C2-NR2F2-ZNF827-NuRD telomeric chromatin complex, but the Pearson correlations were modest, target engagement for these nuclear receptors was weak, and the complex annotation comes from human ALT chromatin rather than mouse neurons.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kmt2d in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons showed a transcriptomic signature that was not recapitulated by other H3K4 methyltransferase perturbations: notably, Kmt2a was among the strongest negative signature neighbors of Kmt2d, ranking second most anticorrelated across comparator perturbations, whereas the Kmt2c paralog was only weakly correlated with no corrected hits. This suggests the Kmt2d enhancer module is not equivalent to other KMT2-family chromatin regulators such as Kmt2a, Kmt2b, or Setd1a, although the anticorrelation is modest and mechanistic basis was not tested.

Rab28 showed only a weak restricted-signature neighbor pattern: across 134 nominal Rab28 gene-cell features, the top same-sign neighbors were Psmb4, Hspa9, Psmc1, Vcp, and Gfpt1, with modest correlations around 0.41–0.48, while the strongest opposite-sign neighbor, Ap3b1, was also weak at about −0.24. This exploratory signal points more toward a proteostasis/vacuolar neighbor space than to retinal-ciliary genes, but it is hypothesis-generating because no Rab28 output was FDR-significant and the largest correlation reached only 0.481.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Spata7 showed only a weak, exploratory relationship in 308 CB GABA cells, where its cerebellar signature was anti-correlated with transition-zone and ciliary disease-family perturbations including B9d1, Ahi1, and Cep290, rather than forming a coherent shared ciliary module; Bbip1 was also considered among comparators. This points to mixed, partly opposing behavior in retinal-ciliopathy and photoreceptor distal connecting-cilium pathway contexts, not a single brain-wide transcriptomic module for SPATA7. Interpretation is limited because Spata7 had just 46 perturbed CB GABA cells and no FDR-supported genes, so the correlations rely on weak whole-transcriptome score vectors.

Figla showed no recurrent convergence with TCF/bHLH or oocyte-program perturbations across the 22 Figla-profiled mouse brain cell types. In these matched brain contrasts, Tcf3, Tcf12, Nobox, Sohlh1, and Pou5f1 produced no FDR-significant genes, and Figla signatures were only weakly correlated with Tcf3, Tcf4, Tcf12, or other oocyte-network perturbations, arguing against a hidden FIGLA-like neuronal module. This null is limited to RNA responses in the same brain atlas and does not address protein interactions in oocytes.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Psmc5 perturbation in responsive neuronal classes up-regulated a recurrent 26S proteasome and ubiquitin-proteostasis rebound module, including Psmc6, Psmc4, Psmd1, Psmd3, Psmd4, Psma5, Ubc, Ubxn4, Ubqln1, Sqstm1, Zfand2a, and Zfand5, across 155 MB Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. The strongest signature was in 155 MB Glut, where proteostasis induction co-occurred with broad neuronal transcript suppression, and the direction is consistent with a compensatory rebound after proteasome impairment, although upstream Nrf1/NFE2L1 activity was inferred rather than directly measured.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Nop56, in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cell type, showed an exploratory restricted signature-neighbor pattern in which its 94-gene FDR<0.25 response correlated positively with Uba5, Rrn3, Ufc1, Ufsp2, Eif4e, and Rbm28, and inversely with Slc17a5, Nefl, and Foxg1. This points to a broader nucleolar-translation/proteostasis network rather than simply opposite effects among canonical Nop56 complex members. The result is hypothesis-generating only, because correlations were computed from one cell type and some neighbors had weak on-target knockdown or target-dominated signatures.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|054 CNU-MGE GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut
full_finding_text: Opa1 perturbation produced a transcriptional stress signature that was unexpectedly recapitulated by Dnm1l in several Opa1-sensitive neuronal classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, while Mff, Yme1l1, Micos13, Slc25a46, Afg3l2, Clpp, and Clpx were weaker neighbors. In 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, Opa1 responses included amino-acid stress induction and mt-encoded RNA loss, with Dnm1l among the closest signature matches. These comparisons used each cell type’s top 200 Opa1 absolute z-score genes and are transcriptomic only, without direct mitochondrial morphology measurements.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Stag1 showed a near-null thalamic response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells and did not phenocopy related cohesin-axis perturbations: whereas Nipbl, Stag2, and Smc1a produced 188, 37, and 24 FDR-significant genes in this same class, Stag1 had none and its score vector aligned only weakly with theirs. This contrast is notable because the assay detected robust cohesin-associated signatures in the same neurons, but the comparison mixes paralog, loader, and core-subunit perturbations, and Stag1 target engagement was weak, so the lack of phenocopy may reflect guide performance as well as biology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Eif4e depletion in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells produced the largest and only target-engaged differential-expression program, marked not by a uniform translational shutdown but by higher Eif4a2, Eif4g2, Eif3l, Eif3f, Eif5, Eef1a1, and proteostasis genes including Hsp90aa1, Hsp90ab1, Stip1, and Psmc6. This pattern is consistent with compensatory rebuilding of cap-dependent translation-initiation and chaperone/proteasome capacity, although the inference is based on mRNA direction only, since translation rates and nascent protein output were not measured; Eif4a2 and Eif4g1 perturbations showed divergent behavior.

Sohlh1 lacked the most informative related-perturbation test because Sohlh2, its SOHLH complex partner and autoregulatory comparator, was not included. The available bHLH-adjacent perturbations—Atoh1, Neurod1, Neurod2, Neurog3, Tcf3, Tcf4, Maf, and Mafg—showed sparse signatures and did not reveal a convergent Sohlh1-like module across the assayed cell types. This comparison is further limited because Maf and Mafg are not SOHLH paralogs, and most other factors are only broad transcription-factor neighbors rather than direct mechanistic comparators.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Nf1 loss showed transcriptomic effects opposite to loss of the downstream RAF/MEK/ERK genes Braf, Map2k1, and Mapk1 on the subset of Nf1-responsive genes, especially in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA cells. In these hotspots, Nf1 was associated with induction of markers including Etv4, Etv5, Dusp4, Dusp6, Spry4, Egr1, Vgf, Scg2, and Unc13a, whereas Braf/Map2k1/Mapk1 perturbations shifted those genes in the opposite direction. This comparison was limited to genes with nominal Nf1 p<0.001 and reflects transcriptomic correlations rather than direct ERK phosphorylation measurements.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chrna1 diverged from neuronal acetylcholine-pathway perturbations in this atlas: despite large matched Chrna1 samples, its target transcript remained unchanged, while related genes showed clear self-depletion in specific neuronal classes. Chrnb2 depleted in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA; Chrna4 depleted in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; and Ache depleted in the same thalamic, midbrain, and posterior classes. This contrast suggests the negative Chrna1 result was not a general failure to perturb acetylcholine-related genes, although only transcript knockdown, not downstream acetylcholine physiology, was assayed.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Baiap2 in cortical IT glutamatergic neurons showed weak positive signature convergence with a postsynaptic density/NMDAR scaffold module, specifically in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut and 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut. In L4-5 IT cells, Ap2s1, Grin2b, and Shank2 were among the closest positive Baiap2 neighbors, while in L2-3 IT cells Grin2b, Syngap1, Shank2, and Dlg4 ranked similarly, with Grin2a and Kcnb1 near the opposite pole. These were low-magnitude, rank-based correlations from nominal Baiap2 signatures, so the signal is hypothesis-generating rather than based on FDR-significant downstream genes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba
full_finding_text: Brd4 perturbation produced transcriptomic signatures that were most reproducibly similar to Trrap and Yy1, especially in the main responsive 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut population, while assayed chromatin-related comparators including Brd1, Chd4, Nipbl, Smc1a, Smc3, and Smarcb1 were much less Brd4-like. This Trrap/Yy1-like pattern also appeared in 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and a restricted 052 Pvalb Gaba response, consistent with convergence on BRD4/P-TEFb and acetylated-chromatin transcriptional regulation rather than a generic chromatin-remodeler state, although the correlations were rank-strong but numerically modest and remain transcriptomic rather than biochemical evidence.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Pitpna showed its strongest recurrent positive signature neighbor as Atp6v0c in the two main responsive cell classes, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. In the thalamic class, Atp6v0c knockdown reproduced 17 of 20 non-target Pitpna FDR genes in the same direction, including overlap across Prkcg, Atp2a2, Scg2, Gabra4, and Kctd16, while in the posterior glutamatergic class both perturbations induced Jun. This convergence is consistent with a V-ATPase/endolysosomal and synaptic-vesicle acidification module rather than phosphoinositide signaling alone, although it is based on transcriptome correlation and overlap rather than epistasis, and Atp6v0c is a signature neighbor rather than a known PITPNA complex member.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Reep2 showed little to no transcriptomic convergence with the ER membrane shaping and ER-derived vesicle dynamics neighborhood defined by Reep1, Atl1, Spast, Atl3, and Vcp. In five robust Reep2-responsive classes—066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—most genome-wide differential expression scores were null, and even where Reep1 or Atl1 were measurably knocked down, full-score correlations with Reep2 stayed near zero. This supports a lack of mRNA-level convergence rather than pathway opposition.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Mycn showed a buffered or near-silent transcriptomic response across thalamic and midbrain contexts, in contrast to a strong, cell-type-restricted MAX-centered program. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, Mycn had no significant genes despite substantial cell numbers, while Max was active, including a nucleolus/ribosome-biogenesis signature with Mdn1, Wdr77, Gnl3, Nop2, Nop56, Rcl1, Utp20, Tsr1, Pwp2, and Polr1a. Brd4 and Huwe1 were also active, but Myc, Alk, and Kdm5b were largely silent; these contrasts are transcriptome-signature level observations, and MAX, BRD4, and HUWE1 may act independently of MYCN.

cell_types: 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut
full_finding_text: Vsx2 showed weak or absent similarity to retinal homeobox neighbors in the assayed brain context. In the only responsive cell type, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, the Vsx2 perturbation signal was itself weak, with Il34 up-regulation, a subthreshold Slc20a1 increase, and nominal synaptic tails, and correlations with Vsx1, Otx2, Rax, Pax6, Crx, Isl1, Ptf1a, and Pax4 were all weak; no perturbation was strongly correlated or anticorrelated, with transcriptome-wide neighbors remaining below |r| < 0.20. This suggests the canonical VSX2 retinal homeobox program was not engaged in these brain neurons, though many top retinal partners were not perturbed and retinal progenitor or bipolar cell contexts were absent.

cell_types: 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Meis1 showed a mostly silent, weakly divergent pattern within the MEIS/TALE-HOX transcription-factor network rather than a coherent interchangeable module with Meis2, Pbx1, Pbx3, Hox, or Phox comparators. Across 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and 308 CB GABA, related-target correlations to Meis1 were small and generally FDR-null; the only related-set FDR < 0.05 signal was Usp48 after Pbx1 perturbation in 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Meis1 versus Meis2 showed an exploratory opposite correlation, but both signatures were FDR-null, and in 308 CB GABA, Hoxc13 and Pbx3 showed only weak same- or opposite-direction trends without supported component signatures.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Cacna1g in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut defined a thalamic state that was not reproduced by related calcium-channel or calcium-dependent perturbations. In this same class, Cacna1c, Cacna2d1, Cacnb4, Camk2b, and Ppp3ca showed significant on-target knockdown, yet their score-vector correlations with the Cacna1g program were near zero; Iyd also changed in the opposite direction after Cacna1g versus Ppp3ca perturbation. No strong global mimic or inverse was detected, while 308 CB GABA showed on-target Cacna1g knockdown with otherwise buffered profiles. These comparisons rely on matched gene-summary score correlations rather than replicate-level joint modeling, and Cacna1h/Cacna1i were not targeted.

cell_types: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Mpdz perturbation in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut produced a nominal CA3-like response that was uncoupled from direct postsynaptic MUPP1 receptor-scaffold comparators: Htr2c, Htr2a, Htr2b, Gabbr1, Gabbr2, Dlg4, Grin1, Syngap1, Camk2a, and Camk2b were near-zero or opposite to the Mpdz score vector, with Gabbr1 anticorrelated. Thus, known MUPP1 receptor and postsynaptic partners did not transcriptionally phenocopy Mpdz in this assay, although this inference is limited by weak primary Mpdz signatures and whole-transcriptome correlations that do not measure receptor localization or synaptic physiology.

Son showed a weak, divergent perturbation signature in nuclear speckle organization and mRNA splicing, rather than behaving like an interchangeable knockdown with related factors such as Srrm2, Srsf1, U2af2, or Prpf6. Across 19 cell classes, Son produced only 3 FDR rows versus 387 for Srrm2 and far more for Srsf1, U2af2, and Prpf6, and its correlations with 18 related RNA-processing perturbations never exceeded r=0.156. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Son had the strongest on-target response but no significant downstream gene, while in 052 Pvalb Gaba, Coro6 decreased with Son; guide efficiency, perturbed-cell number, and Son’s low signal limit these comparisons.

Setdb1 showed a response that diverged from the only related H3K9 methyltransferase perturbation available, Ehmt1: across matched genes, Setdb1-versus-Ehmt1 score correlations were near zero, and Ehmt1 did not significantly induce Atf7ip, Tasor, or the clustered protocadherin module including Pcdhga7, Pcdhga8, Pcdhga9, Pcdhga11, Pcdhga12, Pcdhgb4, and Pcdhgb5. This contrast is consistent with a more specialized SETDB1/HUSH-linked program rather than a generic chromatin-writer loss signature, although direct comparisons to Trim28, Setdb2, Suv39h1, and Suv39h2 were not available.

Hnrnpu was not interchangeable with every STRING-linked hnRNP/RNA-binding neighbor in this neuronal Perturb-seq atlas: Srsf1 and Rnpc3 produced strong transcriptomic responses, while Hnrnpa1, Hnrnpa2b1, Hnrnph2, and Syncrip were weak. Restricted Hnrnpu-signature comparisons pointed to convergence with RNA-processing factors such as U2af2, Prpf6, Snrnp70, Rnpc3, Srsf1, Srrm2, and Tardbp across multiple neuronal cell types, but overall response amplitude still diverged. Because several weak comparators also had weak self-transcript changes, the contrast may reflect guide engagement as well as biology.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Homer2 showed its clearest but still tentative pattern in 308 CB GABA, where a restricted mixed-direction signature aligned with Gria3, Gria4, Grid2, Grm1, and Dlg4, while opposing Syngap1, Fmr1, and Tsc2. This points to a cerebellar glutamate-receptor and synaptic-disease perturbation contrast rather than a simple PSD-complex knockdown phenocopy. Interpretation is limited because Homer2 itself was not detectably lowered in this subclass, and a safe-target perturbation also appeared as an extreme positive neighbor, so the pattern remains a hypothesis requiring validation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Adgrg2 showed a flat target-transcript profile in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic stratum: despite being measured in every Adgrg2 perturbation comparison and assessed in 178 perturbed cells, Adgrg2 itself showed no rank-based evidence of depletion or induction. In the same cell type, the related adhesion-GPCRs Adgrl1, Adgrl2, and Adgrl3 each exhibited clear self-depletion, indicating that the Adgrg2 result is more consistent with target- or context-specific guide performance, expression, or buffering than with a universal failure of adhesion-GPCR perturbations. This contrast is limited to target-transcript depletion and does not imply matched downstream signatures across these family members.

cell_types: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Dlg4 in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut showed a weak, restricted postsynaptic-family signature: Grin2b, Shank2, Camk2a, and Syngap1 ranked on the same side as Dlg4, whereas Grin2a fell on the opposite side. This low-amplitude contrast suggests that, in this cortical IT class, the PSD-95/NMDA-receptor scaffold does not behave as a simple GRIN2A/GRIN2B interchangeability pattern. However, Dlg4 depletion was only borderline in this class (FDR 0.0728) and the correlations were small, so the pattern is best treated as a retestable hypothesis rather than a firm directional call.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Sall4 diverged from available NuRD- and pluripotency-network neighbors rather than phenocopying them in the differentiated brain cell types assayed. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Sall4 had no FDR-significant genes despite about 205 perturbed cells, whereas Chd4 produced 100 FDR-significant genes and Gatad2b and Sox2 also showed significant responses; a second high-count Sall4-null group, 155 MB Glut, showed the same weak pattern. Sall4 score vectors were nearly uncorrelated with Chd4, Gatad2b, Mbd2, Sall1, Sox2, Pou5f1, Myc, and Mycn, suggesting that detectable NuRD-related effects here may not require SALL4, with the caveat that only a subset of these factors was perturbed.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Npy1r did not transcriptionally phenocopy Npy2r, Npy5r, or energy-homeostasis perturbations across the matched cell types 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 046 CTX-CGE GABA, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 308 CB GABA. Score vectors for Npy2r and Npy5r were near-zero correlated with Npy1r, and Agrp, Lepr, Mc3r, and Mc4r were also uncorrelated. A modest opposing Npy1r-Npy5r pattern appeared only in 308 CB GABA, but this was restricted-signature-based and hypothesis-generating, with Npy2r and Npy5r themselves only weakly engaged at the transcript level.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ift88 showed nonconvergent transcriptional effects in this screen: across the curated ciliary and Hedgehog panel, its signature was essentially uncorrelated with Ift81, Ift43, Kif3b, Dync2h1, Ttc21b, Bbs5, Bbs9, Cep290, Rpgrip1l, Smo, Ptch1, Gpr161, and Gli1/2/3, with only weak correlations in unbiased neighbor searches. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the most interpretable Ift88 cell class, nominal decreases in Ift88, Ift57, and Tulp3 appeared, yet Ift81 and Ift43 were weakly anticorrelated with Ift88 and canonical Hedgehog effector transcripts remained quiet. These contrasts are limited to small transcriptional score differences, and all related perturbations were themselves weak.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Gpi1 showed a transcriptionally uncoupled signature from neighboring glucose-metabolism perturbations in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut: within each same cell type, Gpi1 score vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Eno1, Gapdh, Gfpt1, Hk1, Ogt, Pfkm, Pgk1, and Tpi1, despite their shared glycolysis or hexosamine-pathway context. The Gpi1 signal was target-dominated, with only nominal Ogt decrease, and its two strongest signatures had no close positive or opposite global neighbors. This comparison is transcriptomic rather than metabolic, Gpi1 produced little downstream signal, and gRNA efficacy may differ across targets.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Reps1 showed weak transcriptional effects across neurons and diverged from stronger endocytic perturbations: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Reps1 had nominal on-target depletion but no FDR-significant downstream hits, whereas Ap2m1, Ap2s1, Cltc, and Rab7 produced reproducible FDR-level modules, with similar comparator-rich patterns also seen in 155 MB Glut and additional classes including 191 MB P MY GABA, 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. Rala was likewise weak, suggesting a weaker Ral-linked Reps1 branch rather than an interchangeable core AP-2/clathrin/endosomal node, though comparator guides were stronger and represented pathway neighbors rather than direct REPS1 partners.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ap2m1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a transcriptional signature that converged strongly with Ap2s1, consistent with AP-2–complex specificity, but not with several other clathrin-mediated endocytosis perturbations. On the 139-gene Ap2m1 FDR vector, Dnm1 and Synj1 were essentially uncorrelated despite strong self-knockdown, and App and Vps35 were weakly anti-correlated; other neighbors such as Cltc, Dnm2, and Pi4ka were mixed. This restricted-signature result suggests the AP2M1 program is not a generic consequence of all endocytic perturbations, although several comparator perturbations had low cell counts or self-only signatures.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Nipbl in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed partial positive convergence with cohesin components, but not equivalent magnitude: Smc1a, Smc3, and Stag2 were the 1st, 2nd, and 4th nearest positive perturbation neighbors by transcriptome-wide Wilcoxon scores, while Stag1 and Pds5a also lay on the same cohesin-loading/genome-organization axis. However, these cohesin perturbations produced much smaller or undetectable thalamic signatures than Nipbl, which had the stronger 188-gene FDR signature. The correlations were only modest, several complex members lacked FDR-level on-target transcript depletion, and no strong inverse signature was observed.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Tsc2 showed a transcriptomic cross-perturbation pattern consistent with TSC1-TSC2-RHEB-mTORC1 signaling: in the main responsive non-cerebellar classes, Tsc1 was the nearest positive non-self neighbor, while Mtor and, where informative, Rptor were inverse neighbors, most clearly in 155 MB Glut and also in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA. The 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA class shared the broader metabolic response with Tsc1 similarity. These comparisons were based on transcriptomic correlation rather than epistatic rescue, and Rheb and Tbc1d7 were not represented in the perturbation index.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chl1 knockdown was largely uncoupled from related adhesion and scaffold perturbations across 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA: Chl1 score vectors were nearly uncorrelated with L1cam, Nrcam, Ncam1, Cntn1, Cntnap1, Cntnap2, and Ank3. The contrast was strongest in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where Ank3 induced 121 FDR-significant genes while Chl1 yielded only its own depletion; similarly, in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, Chl1 showed on-target depletion without corrected non-Chl1 markers. Because the whole-transcriptome Chl1 signal was weak, this near-zero correlation could reflect buffering or limited downstream signal rather than true biochemical dissociation within CHL1/L1-family adhesion pathways.

Uqcrb showed a divergent, weak or noisy Perturb-seq profile relative to better-engaged mitochondrial respiratory electron transport/complex III perturbations. Unlike Uqcrc1, Uqcrc2, Uqcrfs1, Cyc1, and Ttc19, which showed significant self-knockdown in multiple matched contrasts, Uqcrb showed none, and a restricted neighbor scan using the top 50 absolute Uqcrb-score genes per cell type did not stably recover complex-III members as positive or negative signature neighbors, often placing Safe_target-like signatures nearby. This limits treating assayed complex-III sgRNAs as interchangeable, although the divergence is confounded by the weaker Uqcrb target-transcript effect.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Sim1 showed little convergence with its expected partner Arnt2: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, both perturbations were weak, Arnt2 was nearly silent, and the aligned Sim1-Arnt2 score correlation was near zero. This cautions against inferring the canonical SIM1-ARNT2 PVN/SON neuroendocrine differentiation program here, especially since the assayed broad cell classes may not match that developmental context. In the same matrix, however, Bmal1 and Clock produced robust signatures, including Dbp and Nr1d2 responses, indicating that transcription-factor phenotypes were detectable despite the weak Sim1/Arnt2 effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Champ1 showed a weak but biologically aligned convergence with Pogz in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut thalamic glutamatergic class: Pogz was the top positive neighbor of the Champ1 restricted signature, with cosine similarity 0.284 computed over the 500 strongest Champ1 features and rank 1 among 2,045 perturbations. This match was restricted to this cell type rather than pan-neuronal, and it is exploratory because full-transcriptome correlation was low and neither Champ1 nor Pogz had FDR-significant genes in this class, despite stronger phenotypes being detectable for other perturbations such as Chd8 and Nipbl.

Orc6 perturbation did not produce a detectable transcriptional response in the expected replication-licensing or proliferation neighborhoods: Orc1–Orc5, Cdc6, Cdt1, Mcm2–Mcm7, and Cdc45, as well as Pcna, Mki67, Top2a, Ccna2, and Ccnb1, were all FDR-null. In these assayed neuronal classes, the Orc6 signature therefore appeared uncoupled from canonical origin recognition complex/pre-replication-complex assembly and G1/S proliferation-marker programs. This was based on a targeted transcript check rather than a full protein-complex or cell-cycle assay.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Cdkn2a did not phenocopy the RB/E2F transcriptional state in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: in this cell type, Rb1 and E2f4 perturbations produced strong, FDR-significant signatures, whereas Cdkn2a showed no detectable signature despite more Cdkn2a cells, and its transcriptome-wide correlations with Rb1 and E2f4 were near zero (-0.004 and 0.061). This suggests the p16INK4a-CDK4/6-RB1-E2F G1/S control arm is assay-detectable here but does not propagate from Cdkn2a under baseline conditions, although only a subset of CDKN2A-neighbor perturbations was available and the correlation analysis does not localize the molecular block.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Mga showed gene-specific concordance with Max rather than a shared whole-transcriptome phenocopy. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the strongest Mga-responsive class, Obscn and Stag3 were upregulated and Max also induced Stag3 and Obscn, although Mga mRNA itself was not reduced. In 155 MB Glut, Stag3 reached significance after both Mga and Max perturbation. However, across all genes no perturbation was a strong signature neighbor of Mga: the top correlations were only r=0.090 and r=0.119, while Max–Mga correlations were just r=0.038 and r=0.032, suggesting local concordance without a global MYC/MAX transcriptional-state shift; noisy single-cell Wilcoxon score vectors may also obscure a small true module.

cell_types: 046 CTX-CGE GABA
full_finding_text: Ednrb showed only weak, restricted convergence with the endothelin receptor / GPCR phosphatidylinositol-calcium signaling neighborhood in 046 CTX-CGE GABA cells. A Plcb1 similarity appeared in the restricted Ednrb top-200 signature, where Plcb1 ranked 14/2,016, but this signal disappeared at whole-transcriptome scale, with Ednrb–Plcb1 correlation of only r=0.0738 and no CTX-CGE FDR-significant Plcb1 program. No strong match to Ednra or other comparators was seen, so the result is best viewed as a hypothesis-generating PLC echo rather than robust EDNRB pathway activation.

Trrap perturbation in the assayed mature neuronal cell types was uncoupled from canonical MYC/E2F cell-cycle transcription: none of 19 proliferation genes, including Mki67, Top2a, Pcna, Mcm2-7, Ccne1/2, Ccna2, Cdk1, E2f1/2, Myc, Mycn, Cdc20, and Birc5, reached significance. The assayed Myc perturbation also did not phenocopy Trrap, showing no FDR-significant genes and near-zero signature correlations, although this comparison is limited because Myc itself showed weak RNA-level engagement, making it a negative control rather than a definitive epistasis test.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Smc1a showed a distinctive response in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut thalamic cell type, where it formed the main corrected signature and converged with Nipbl and Stag2, but not with all assayed cohesin/CdLS-family perturbations. In this Smc1a-responsive class, Smc3, Stag1, Pds5a, and Hdac8 had zero genes at FDR < 0.05, whereas Smc1a, Stag2, and Nipbl did, suggesting that cohesin loading and chromatin architecture perturbations were not interchangeable in postmitotic brain cells. However, these negative comparators also showed weak target-transcript knockdown, so the null results may reflect guide performance as well as biology.

Orc4 did not show a shared detectable ORC-complex loss signature with the only assayed canonical ORC/pre-RC comparator, Orc6: across 21 shared cell types, Orc4–Orc6 full-score correlations were near zero, despite both genes being core members of the origin-recognition complex involved in DNA replication origin licensing and pre-replicative complex assembly. Because both perturbations had weak, FDR-negative transcriptomic signatures, this result is best interpreted as a negative convergence test in this dataset rather than proof that Orc4 and Orc6 have distinct biology.

cell_types: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Grin2b produced its largest transcriptomic response in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut cells, with predominantly down-regulated synaptic and activity-linked genes, and in this same cell class its signature diverged strongly from Grin2a: the score vectors were anticorrelated, their FDR-significant genes did not overlap, and Grin2a was a strong negative Grin2b signature neighbor. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Grin2b showed a compact all-negative program overlapping the L2/3 pattern at Vgf, Kcnv1, Rph3a, and Diras2. Because Grin2a depletion in L2/3 IT cells was only nominal and not FDR-significant, this contrast should be read as transcriptomic rather than a quantitative receptor-function comparison.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Atp2c1 showed little downstream breadth despite engagement in two glutamatergic cell types. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Atp2c1, Atp2b2, Atp2b3, Cacnb4, and Calm3 were target-only at FDR 0.05, whereas Atp2a2 and Atp2b1 produced broad transcriptional outputs. In 155 MB Glut, only Atp2a2 yielded more than the self-transcript row among the curated calcium comparators, and Atp2c1 had no FDR-significant non-target genes. These differences suggest that shared calcium-handling or P-type ATPase annotation did not predict a shared RNA signature, with the caveat that comparators act in different compartments and were perturbed with different efficiencies.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kmt2c showed weak and divergent transcriptional responses rather than phenocopying related COMPASS/H3K4-family perturbations. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Kmt2c was the only context with an FDR-supported DEG and an exploratory Prnp/Dop1b/Ckap5 pattern, whereas Kmt2d and Kmt2b had their own significant genes without that pattern. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Kmt2d, Kmt2b, Kmt2a, Kdm6a, and Setd1a showed corrected effects while Kmt2c again had none. These contrasts are tempered by unequal guide-cell counts, missing canonical subunits, and the relatively weak Kmt2c arm.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA|054 CNU-MGE GABA
full_finding_text: Glis2 showed largely orthogonal transcriptomic score vectors to Glis3, canonical GLI/Hedgehog components, and ciliary transport perturbations across the profiled neuronal classes, including 308 CB GABA and 054 CNU-MGE GABA. Glis2–Glis3 correlations were essentially zero, and comparisons with Gli1, Gli2, Gli3, Ptch1, Ptch2, Smo, Ift43, Ift81, Ift88, Ttc8, Ttc21b, Dync2h1, Dync2i1, and Kif3b never exceeded |r|=0.16. The nearest neighbors were only weak exploratory signals in cerebellar GABA neurons, including inverse Zic3 and same-direction B9d1, and interpretation is limited because the Glis2 anchor signature lacked FDR-significant genes.

Nr2c1 did not show an interchangeable Perturb-seq signature with its heterodimeric partner/paralog Nr2c2 in this brain assay: across 22 shared cell-type contrasts, their score vectors were essentially uncorrelated, with a median Pearson r of 0.008 and a range from -0.084 to 0.036. This suggests that matching neuronal mRNA phenotypes should not be assumed for these two DRED nuclear receptors here, although the contrast is tempered by weak self-transcript depletion for both perturbations, including poor target-transcript engagement for Nr2c2.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Rack1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons modestly decreased Ppp2r1a, but this did not phenocopy direct Ppp2r1a loss. In this thalamic class, only two Rack1-responsive transcripts reached FDR≤0.05, whereas direct Ppp2r1a perturbation produced a much broader transcriptional response with 1,292 FDR≤0.05 genes and only weak correlation with the Rack1 signature. Thus, within RACK1-PP2A signaling, the observed effect is a small transcriptional decrease in Ppp2r1a rather than a direct PP2A-loss-like program, and PP2A holoenzyme activity or RACK1-PP2A protein interactions were not measured.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tfdp2 did not reproduce the strong E2f4/Rb1 G1/S-like transcriptional module in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons: whereas E2f4 and Rb1 upregulated DNA-replication and mitotic genes such as Rad18, Tacc3, Tube1, Cenpw, Blm, Dnmt1, Tipin, Prim1, Lig1, Mcm2, Mcm6, and Pcna, Tfdp2 showed no FDR-significant change, and score-vector correlations with E2f4 and Rb1 were only 0.036 and 0.079. The Tfdp1 paralog also lacked a broad robust signature, suggesting these related TFDP/E2F nodes were not interchangeable in this neuronal assay, although this contrast is transcriptomic and weakened by the lack of confirmed Tfdp2 mRNA depletion.

cell_types: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Grin2a perturbation in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut produced a cortical transcriptomic program that was opposed rather than phenocopied by Grin2b: Grin2b was the second strongest negative all-gene neighbor of Grin2a, and 18 of 20 Grin2a FDR genes shifted in the opposite direction, including induction markers such as Nptx2, Bdnf, and Ptgs2. This opposition was weaker in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, where the downstream response was more restricted and centered on Nptx2. Other NMDA receptor or postsynaptic-neighbor perturbations, including Grin1, Grin2d, Grin3a, and Dlg4, also did not match the Grin2a program. The correlations were low in absolute magnitude and reflect transcriptomic signatures only, although the L2/3 sign opposition was concentrated among FDR Grin2a genes.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Sox10 showed only a weak, exploratory signature-neighbor pattern in 308 CB GABA cells. In this cell type, B3galnt1 had the lowest nominal Sox10-associated p value but no downstream gene reached FDR<0.05, with B3galnt1 itself at FDR 0.414. The strongest whole-transcriptome neighbors were modest correlations with Wdr26, Cckar, and Ranbp2, while related Sox2, Sox9, Myrf, and Sox5 signatures were only weakly correlated or anticorrelated (about |r|≤0.32, with Myrf and Sox5 ≤0.21). These data do not support a recognizable SOX10/myelin convergence.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Fzd6 perturbation was largely uncoupled from the canonical Wnt/beta-catenin transcriptional program seen after Ctnnb1 loss. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ctnnb1 knockdown produced a broad FDR-significant response including Axin2, whereas Fzd6 had no adjusted hits and an essentially uncorrelated genome-wide score vector; similar neutrality was seen in 145 MH-LH TH Glut and 155 MB Glut, despite strong Celsr2 self-limited effects in the latter. The weakest Fzd6 nominal signal did not survive correction, and this contrast does not exclude receptor-proximal PCP or calcium signaling.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chd8 knockdown in differentiated mouse-brain neuronal classes did not produce the expected canonical Wnt/β-catenin or proliferative cell-cycle de-repression. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, transcripts such as Axin2, Myc, Ccnd1, Lef1, Tcf7l2, Ctnnb1, Pcna, Mki67, and Top2a were not detectably activated, and Ctnnb1 perturbation did not phenocopy the Chd8 signature. Instead, the observed output was more neuron-class-specific and biased toward RNA-processing programs, while negative transcript evidence still leaves open unmeasured β-catenin, noncanonical Wnt, or developmental-stage-specific effects.

Stag1 perturbation did not produce corrected transcriptional compensation among the assayed cohesin-pathway genes: Stag2, Smc1a, Smc3, Nipbl, Pds5a, Hdac8, and Mcph1 were not significant Stag1-response genes, with minimum FDR values of 1.0, and no measurable induction or repression after correction. This lack of mRNA response was observed across profiled subclasses, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, even though related cohesin-complex and sister-chromatid-cohesion genes can be active there. The result is limited to transcript abundance in a small curated gene set and does not address cohesin loading, protein occupancy, loop extrusion, or post-translational regulation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Pds5a showed a notably weak perturbation signature in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: despite 137 Pds5a cells, it yielded no FDR-significant genes, whereas related cohesin or chromatin regulators in the same assay produced robust responses, including Ctcf, Nipbl, Stag2, and Smc1a, and Pds5a genome-wide differential-expression vectors had only small correlations with these perturbations. This suggests the null Pds5a result is perturbation-specific rather than a general lack of cohesin sensitivity in this cell type, although stronger knockdown for the comparator genes could explain part of the contrast and argues against overinterpreting it as true separation from cohesin biology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Robo1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a target-only knockdown pattern: Robo1 was the strongest differentially expressed gene, but no non-target mRNAs reached significance, indicating buffered downstream transcriptional responses. In the same thalamic class, Cdc42 perturbation likewise reduced only Cdc42, yielding a parallel target-only signature within ROBO-linked Rho-family/CDC42 cytoskeletal signaling. This supports mRNA-level pathway uncoupling in this cell type, while the dataset does not establish biochemical ROBO1-to-CDC42 epistasis, and Cdc42 remains a broadly shared Rho-family node.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Polr3b in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons showed a response that diverged sharply from the Pol III pathway neighbor Bdp1: Polr3b induced a Rap/adhesion program including Rap1gap, Adgrb1, and Rap2a, whereas Bdp1 induced Ddit3 and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase genes such as Mars1, Iars, Lars, Aars, Cars, and Yars. The two FDR<0.05 hit lists had no genes in common and only weak score correlation, consistent with distinct effects of a core Pol III subunit versus a TFIIIB initiation factor; notably, neither perturbation significantly depleted its own mRNA.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA
full_finding_text: Dctn1 knockdown induced a recurrent SREBP-like cholesterol and fatty-acid biosynthesis program, with up-regulation of Insig1, Msmo1, Fdps, Ldlr, Hmgcr, Hmgcs1, Dhcr24, Cyp51, Fasn, Sqle, Nsdhl, Fdft1, and Srebf2, rather than a broad mixed stress response. The effect was strongest in 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with smaller or lower-cell-count responses in hypothalamic, pineal, and MGE-family GABAergic classes. In several classes, Dync1h1 and sometimes Rab7 partially phenocopied this sterol module, whereas Srebf2 knockdown shifted it in the opposite direction. The assay measured mRNA only, so SREBP2 cleavage, sterol content, and dynein cargo movement were not directly assessed.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Txndc15 in 155 MB Glut shows a sterol-module response that follows Marchf6-loss direction and opposes Srebf2-loss direction: cholesterol genes such as Hmgcs1, Insig1, Ldlr, Fdft1, Dhcr24, Msmo1, Cyp51, Hmgcr, Fdps, and Sqle are up-regulated with Txndc15 or Marchf6 perturbation, whereas Srebf2 perturbation drives them downward. This coupling is cell-type gated, because in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut the cholesterol module is still moved by Marchf6 and Srebf2 perturbations but not by Txndc15, despite strong Txndc15 knockdown. Whole-transcriptome correlations are weak, so the convergence appears module-restricted.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Notch3 showed weak, buffered transcriptomic effects in this neuronal Perturb-seq dataset, and restricted neighbor analysis did not identify strong positive or negative relationships with Notch1, Notch2, Notch4, Dll1, Adam10, or Psen1.
