In contrast, Mib1 diverged sharply, driving a recurrent sterol/cholesterol biosynthesis program with Insig1, Dhcr24, Fdft1, Ldlr, Msmo1, Hmgcs1, Hmgcr, Srebf2, Fdps, and Nsdhl across classes including 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA. This pattern suggests either Notch-independent Mib1 biology or a sender-cell process not captured by receptor-level transcriptomic states here.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Mib1 showed a sterol-gene signature that was opposed by Srebf2 perturbation across seven broad-response classes, linking Mib1 loss to activation rather than repression of an SREBP2-related cholesterol program. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut, Mib1 was associated with higher sterol-panel scores and induction of genes including Insig1, Hmgcr, Msmo1, Ldlr, Fdps, Fdft1, Dhcr24, Nsdhl, Lss, Cyp51, and Sqle, whereas Srebf2 perturbation showed the opposite direction. This comparison is based on a restricted sterol-gene panel rather than full-transcriptome correlations.

Acsl4 knockdown drove a sterol-module program opposite to direct Srebf2 perturbation: genes induced after Acsl4 loss were repressed when Srebf2 was perturbed, placing the Acsl4 response on the activation side of the SREBP2 sterol program rather than phenocopying Srebf2 loss. The recurrently increased genes included Srebf2, Hmgcs1, Hmgcr, Insig1, Sqle, Msmo1, Dhcr24, Cyp51, Fdft1, and Ldlr, with the strongest downstream Acsl4 hit in L2/3 IT cortical glutamatergic neurons and broader forebrain recurrence, while some midbrain/thalamic glutamatergic types appeared buffered. This comparison is transcriptomic only, since SREBP2 cleavage, nuclear localization, and sterol abundance were not measured.

Pcdh19 perturbation showed no recurrent FDR-significant mRNA response in the literature-nominated PCDH19 pathways, including Cdh2/N-cadherin adhesion, GABA_A receptor inhibitory signaling, and NMDAR/immediate-early-gene modules such as Grin1/Grin2a/Grin2b/Grin2c, Fos, Egr1-3, Arc, Junb, Npas4, Nr4a1, and Bdnf. In 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and 054 CNU-MGE GABA cells, Pcdh19 engagement was weak or null-like, and Cdh2 knockdown diverged rather than phenocopied Pcdh19. These results are limited to transcript-level readouts, consistent with the possibility that reported PCDH19 mechanisms are protein-localization, electrophysiologic, developmental, or activity-dependent rather than steady-state adult-brain mRNA modules.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Srebf2 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut was associated with coordinated down-regulation of a cholesterol-biosynthetic module, including Insig1, Dhcr24, Msmo1, Cyp51, Hmgcr, Fdft1, Hmgcs1, Fdps, and Ldlr, whereas Marchf6, Dctn1, and Dync1h1 perturbations drove these sterol genes upward in the same response-capable neuronal classes. This suggests a bidirectional sterol pathway state, but whole-signature correlations were weak, and especially for Dctn1/Dync1h1 the contrast is best viewed as an indirect module-level hypothesis rather than a direct mechanism.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Marchf6 elicited a sterol/cholesterol-biosynthesis transcriptional module in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut cells, and Srebf2 perturbation acted as an internal directional control by driving the same genes in the opposite direction. In these Marchf6-responsive classes, Srebf2 decreased Dhcr24, Insig1, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, Cyp51, Sqle, and Ldlr, consistent with an SREBP-regulated cholesterol pathway signature. This supports SREBP2-regulon identity for the Marchf6-induced module, but the evidence is transcriptional and does not show that SREBF2 protein processing mediates the Marchf6 response.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Dctn1 knockdown in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA was opposed by Srebf2 knockdown, which down-regulated several of the same sterol genes that Dctn1 loss up-regulated, including Insig1, Msmo1, Ldlr, Dhcr24, Cyp51, Fdps, and Hmgcs1. This opposing pattern in the responsive neuronal classes is consistent with Dctn1 acting upstream of a SREBP-regulated sterol-demand program rather than simply reducing the Srebf2 transcriptional effector, although the inference comes from perturbation-level transcriptomes and did not assay SREBP2 cleavage or direct chromatin binding.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Pex14 loss shows a low-amplitude, recurrent upward bias in SREBF2/cholesterol-homeostasis genes, strongest in 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where Cyp51, Dhcr24, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, Stard4, Insig1, Fdft1, Nsdhl, and Dhcr7 are up-ranked; weaker or exploratory versions appear in 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 217 P MY Pineal Glut, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. In matched regions, Srebf2 knockdown drives the same panel downward, consistent with sterol-homeostatic compensation rather than generic stress, but this signal is post hoc and rank-based, most individual genes remain FDR=1, and the Pineal Glut result comes from weak Pex14 self-knockdown with only 30 perturbed cells.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Agps in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut shows a sterol-response signature that is directionally opposite to Srebf2 perturbation in the same cell class: Agps is associated with upregulation of an SREBP2-linked cholesterol and sterol biosynthesis module centered on Dhcr24 and including Insig1, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, Cyp51, and Sqle, whereas Srebf2 loss drives these genes down. This contrast supports interpreting the Agps pattern as activation of an SREBP2/sterol program rather than generic high expression, although the Agps effect is weaker and mostly nominal, with only one Agps stratum showing an FDR-significant gene and only weak convergence with Far1, Pex13, and Pex14.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Selenoi perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons upregulated a sterol/SREBP2-associated program, and Srebf2 moved the shared cholesterol genes in the opposite direction, with Dhcr24, Insig1, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, Cyp51, and Sqle decreased at FDR<0.05. In the same neuronal class, Pcyt2 was the closest positive Selenoi neighbor, whereas Srebf2 was a leading negative neighbor, consistent with Selenoi/Pcyt2 acting upstream of an SREBP2-dependent transcriptional program. Whole-transcriptome correlations were small, so the directional inference is strongest for the curated sterol genes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Map1b in the glutamatergic classes 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut showed a self-only signature, closely matching Mapt, with depletion of the target transcript but little downstream mRNA response. In contrast, Dctn1 in these same classes produced a broad secondary sterol/cholesterol program, with induction of Insig1, Msmo1, Hmgcs1, Fdps, Ldlr, Hmgcr, and Fdft1, while full-gene score correlations between Map1b and Dctn1, Dync1h1, Mapt, or Gsk3b remained near zero. This contrast is transcriptomic and does not establish a direct MAP1B-DCTN1 pathway.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Tsc1 perturbation produced a recurring neuronal program marked by upregulation of lysosomal/vacuolar proteostasis genes such as Atp6v0b, Dpp7, Lamp2, and Mcoln1 together with sterol-biosynthesis genes including Cyp51, Dhcr7, Hmgcs1, Insig1, Ldlr, and Msmo1, plus Cpeb1, with a smaller recurrent downregulated arm. The strongest responses were in 155 MB Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; the pattern resembles Tsc2 and opposes Mtor/Rptor in a cell-type-specific manner. These inferences come from RNA differential expression only, without measurements of phosphorylation, SREBP cleavage, or lysosomal flux.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Depdc5 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells showed a perturbation signature most similar to the mTORC1 negative regulators Tsc2 and Tsc1, and opposite to Mtor, consistent with a shared mTORC1-direction state rather than a Depdc5-specific artifact. This same cell type was the only one with FDR-resolved downstream genes and carried a cholesterol/ER program including Ldlr, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, and Insig1, with exploratory Pik3r1/Pik3r3 biomarkers. The Depdc5–Mtor anticorrelation was modest across whole-rank signatures, and Mtor itself had only two FDR hits here.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Ctsb knockdown did not phenocopy upstream lysosome regulators Rab7 or Tsc1/Tsc2 in this Perturb-seq library. In 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, strong Ctsb repression often lacked additional FDR-significant non-target genes, whereas Rab7 and Tsc1/Tsc2 produced broad Lamp2/Atp6v0b/Dpp7/Insig1-rich endolysosomal and cholesterol programs, with neighbors such as Mcoln1 and Grn. This cross-perturbation contrast suggests detectable lysosome-linked remodeling in the assay, but loss of the terminal protease Ctsb was buffered relative to upstream trafficking or mTOR-regulatory nodes.

cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Dync1h1 loss showed SREBP-like polarity rather than Srebf2-loss polarity: in 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, Dync1h1 perturbation induced sterol/cholesterol biosynthesis genes including Insig1, Msmo1, Dhcr24, and Cyp51, whereas direct Srebf2 knockdown repressed these same genes. The largest response occurred in midbrain glutamatergic neurons, and hypothalamic/CNU GABA and midbrain/pons/medulla GABA neurons also showed significant sterol induction. This pattern is consistent with compensatory endogenous SREBP activation, but the opposite transcript direction alone does not show that Dync1h1 acts upstream of SCAP-SREBP.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Dnm1l perturbation converged with Opa1 on a shared stress-metabolic RNA program in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA cells, despite these genes acting on opposite sides of mitochondrial dynamics. In these Dnm1l-sensitive subclasses, Opa1 showed FDR-significant induction of Asns, Cars, Ddit3, Chac1, and Mars1, and its score vector correlated with the top-300 Dnm1l marker vector; Shmt2, Aldh1l2, and Slc7a5 were also part of the broader signature. This supports mitochondrial shape imbalance, rather than Dnm1l loss alone, as a route to an ISR-like neuronal stress state, although convergence was assessed only at RNA level and with a restricted 300-gene correlation screen.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Hjv in cerebellar GABA cells showed only a modest, exploratory pathway-neighbor pattern: its full differential-expression score vector weakly aligned with Bmpr1b and R-SMAD perturbations, including Smad9, Smad3, Smad1, Smad2, Smad4, and Smad6, but diverged from Neo1 and from the type-II receptor branch genes Acvr2a and Bmpr2. Because this comparison was limited to the 308 CB GABA class, Hjv itself had no FDR-significant CB GABA gene, and absolute correlations were small, the result argues against treating all HJV-binding or BMP-receptor neighbors as interchangeable in brain cells.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Ptpn1 was uncoupled from a strong RTK/Ras/MAPK-like, Vgf-centered neuronal response seen with Nf1, Braf, and Map2k1 perturbations. In several classes, including 052 Pvalb Gaba, 054 CNU-MGE GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, Nf1 drove Vgf/Ptpn5-associated signatures in the opposite direction to Braf or Map2k1, whereas Ptpn1 did not reproduce this module and left Vgf and Ptpn5 unchanged across tested cell types. The strongest comparator effects occurred where Ptpn1 target-transcript suppression was weak, and Nf1, Braf, and Map2k1 are not direct PTPN1 substrates.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kras showed an interpretable but nominal RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK-like signal only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, where perturbation weakly decreased Vgf, Dusp6, Ptpn5, Etv5, and Atp2a2, with Vgf the strongest change. In the same cell type, Braf and Map2k1 perturbations drove these genes downward, whereas Nf1 drove them upward, and a restricted 54-gene Kras signature linked Kras positively to Braf/Map2k1 and inversely to Nf1. This pattern fits expected pathway direction, but all Kras module genes had FDR=1.0 and the signature uses dataset-defined outputs rather than a comprehensive ERK target set.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Htt showed a sterol-gene module that converged with Dctn1 and Dync1h1 perturbations, linking the response to a dynein/dynactin transport axis rather than a purely nuclear mechanism. In 155 MB Glut, Dctn1 and Dync1h1 were the closest positive neighbors to Htt and produced a stronger version of the same sterol program, with upregulation of genes including Insig1, Hmgcs1, Msmo1, and Fdps. Similar but weaker, cell-type-specific overlap appeared in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 191 MB P MY GABA. The convergence was strongest for a restricted 16-gene sterol panel, while whole-transcriptome correlations with Htt were only modest, and Hap1 diverged despite target engagement.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Shoc2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut shows the expected RAF/MEK polarity: its perturbation resembles Braf and Map2k1 loss and opposes Nf1 loss, consistent with a Ras-RAF-MAPK axis rather than an isolated RNA change. In this cell class, Shoc2, Braf, and Map2k1 all downregulated Vgf, with Braf and Map2k1 also lowering Ptpn5 and Unc13a, whereas Nf1 loss upregulated Vgf, Ptpn5, Atp2a2, and Etv5. However, full-vector correlations were small in absolute value, and the strongest convergence was restricted to this one thalamic glutamatergic class.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Naa15 showed modest positive signature similarity to RNA-processing/spliceosome and proteasome/proteostasis perturbations, especially in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, with concordant but lower-count effects in 191 MB P MY GABA. Nearest non-self neighbors included Prpf6, Cdc40, Ddx23, Hnrnpu, U2af2, Rnpc3, Snrnp70, and proteostasis genes such as Pomp, Psmc1, Psmb4, and Psmc5. However, the strongest non-self correlation was only 0.214, and no strong anti-correlated or mirror-image perturbation emerged, so this module is hypothesis-generating rather than definitive.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Bmpr1b in 308 CB GABA showed a mixed BMP-pathway pattern: its transcriptomic signature was only weakly concordant with Smad1, Smad9, Smad6, Smad4, and Acvr2b, but diverged from or was anticorrelated with Bmpr2, Acvr2a, Acvr1, and Bmpr1a, despite their curated placement in the same BMP receptor–SMAD module. The sole FDR-significant Bmpr1b hit in this class, Rnf157 up-regulation, was not reproduced at the single-gene level by other assayed BMP/TGF-beta receptor or SMAD perturbations, so these small, sparse correlations remain exploratory and may reflect context, receptor usage, or perturbation-strength differences.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Atg5 in 155 MB Glut showed a restricted neighbor signature: across the 200 strongest Atg5-ranked genes, its profile locally resembled Rb1cc1, Atg16l1, Becn1, Tsc1, and proteasome-linked perturbations including Pomp, Psmb4, Psmc1, and Psmc5, but was neutral to opposite for Map1lc3a and Sqstm1. This suggests that autophagy-related perturbations were not interchangeable in this assay, separating Atg5-proximal or proteostasis-neighbor effects from downstream LC3/p62 perturbations. A caveat is that this convergence was limited to the top-200 Atg5 genes, while full-transcriptome correlations were near zero.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tmco1 knockdown in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells did not elicit a canonical ER unfolded-protein-response or integrated-stress-response program: despite nominal Tmco1 self-depletion, there were 0 FDR-significant genes and no induction of Ddit3, Chac1, Xbp1, Herpud1, or Hspa5. In the same cell class, the comparator Atp2a2 loss robustly activated this stress module, with 187 FDR-significant genes including strong up-regulation of those markers. This contrast indicates the assay and cell type could mount an ER-stress RNA response, while also noting that Atp2a2 and Tmco1 perturb opposite ER Ca2+ fluxes and therefore need not phenocopy each other.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Fnip1 showed weaker effects than its lysosomal and mTOR pathway neighbors in this mouse-brain Perturb-seq dataset: despite nominal on-target depletion in 155 MB Glut, it produced no FDR-significant downstream genes there or in 052 Pvalb Gaba and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. In contrast, Tsc1, Tsc2, Atp6v0a1, Atp6v1a, Atp6v1b2, Depdc5, Mtor, Sqstm1, and Rb1cc1 had adjusted signatures, indicating that the lack of an Fnip1 program was specific to Fnip1 target engagement or biology rather than a general failure to detect lysosome/mTOR perturbations; however, these comparators are pathway neighbors, not FLCN-FNIP complex members, and target-transcript engagement differed across perturbations.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Cltc perturbation in 155 MB Glut and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA cells most closely matched Vps37a, Vps53, Atp6v0c, Atp6v1a, Psmb4, Psmc1, Psmc5, and Sec31a signatures, whereas Ap2s1, Ap2m1, Dnm1, Dnm2, Synj1, Sorl1, and Vps35 were usually much weaker or even anticorrelated; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut showed a large synaptic-gene response despite no detectable Cltc mRNA reduction in that comparison. Overall, the Cltc RNA state appeared closer to broader endomembrane/proteostasis perturbations than to all canonical endocytic partners, though this restricted-signature analysis used only the 100 lowest nominal-p Cltc genes per cell type and may be influenced by guide potency and cargo- or kinetics-specific effects.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Caml showed weak but recurrent positive signature convergence with Atp6v0c, Cltc, Psmb4, Psmc1, Psmc5, Pomp, Sec31a, Vps37a, and Vps54, especially across 052 Pvalb Gaba, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, making V-ATPase, cytoplasmic-vesicle, and proteasome perturbations its nearest transcriptomic neighbors rather than any strong opposite neighbor. Direct WRB/ASNA1/GET-family comparators were not present, and these modest score-based correlations should be viewed as hypotheses about shared cellular state, not physical interaction with CAML.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut
full_finding_text: Bcap31 showed a buffered, target-only transcriptional phenotype that diverged sharply from the ER-mitochondrial fission neighbor Dnm1l. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut cells, Bcap31 depletion was significant but generally did not induce secondary FDR-significant genes or ER-stress markers. By contrast, Dnm1l elicited a strong CHOP/ATF4-like amino-acid stress program, including Asns, Cars, Ddit3, and Chac1, in overlapping classes, with near-zero score-vector correlation to Bcap31; this contrast reflects pathway-neighbor divergence rather than same-complex equivalence.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Thoc2 showed a weak positive signature neighborhood enriched for RNA processing, spliceosome, and nuclear transport perturbations, rather than a strong opposing target. In 052 Pvalb Gaba, Snrnp70, Tpr, Prpf6, U2af2, and Ranbp2 ranked among the closest same-direction neighbors, and in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Tpr, Prpf6, Snrnp70, Rnpc3, and U2af2 showed a similar pattern; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut also placed Tpr and Ddx39b near Thoc2 despite no FDR-level downstream response. These effects were exploratory and rank-based, with correlations only around 0.1–0.2, no strong anti-correlated neighbor, and some nonspecific proteasome neighbors.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Braf-responsive genes were opposed by Nf1 perturbation. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Nf1 increased the Braf/Map2k1-downregulated genes Vgf, Ptpn5, Atp2a2, and Etv5, while in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA it increased Vgf, opposite to Braf. This pattern fits a RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK transcriptional output in which positive regulators such as Braf, Map2k1, Ntrk2, and Shoc2 decrease the Vgf-centered module, whereas Nf1 increases it; Raf1 did not phenocopy this. Caveats are that the Nf1 transcript row was not FDR-significantly depleted and the 066 effect is largely Vgf-only.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Gabrd in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed only weak transcriptomic convergence with a few GABA-A receptor subunit perturbations: Gabrb2, Gabra1, and Gabra4 were its nearest positive neighbors, qualitatively consistent with alpha/beta/delta receptor assembly. However, the strongest non-self correlation was small (r=0.138), and other related perturbations, including Gabrg2, Gabrb1, Gabra2, Gad1, Gad2, Slc6a1, and the top negative neighbor Grin1, were weak, near zero, or anticorrelated, arguing against treating GABA-A-related knockdowns as interchangeable signatures in this cell type.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Rasa2 diverged sharply from the related RasGAP Nf1 in this Perturb-seq dataset: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, Nf1 showed strong FDR-significant neuronal responses, including induction of Vgf, Ptpn5, and Etv5 in the thalamic glutamatergic type and Vgf and Egr1 in the midbrain glutamatergic type, whereas matched Rasa2 perturbations were essentially flat. This supports non-interchangeability within RAS-GTP hydrolysis by RasGAPs, although Rasa2 target engagement was weak and the contrast relies on aggregate signatures rather than matched edits in identical cells.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Spred2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut did not reproduce the Nf1-like, Braf-opposed Ras/MAPK transcriptional module, even though this class had the largest Spred2 sample size. In the same neurons, Nf1 and Braf showed strong opposite effects on Vgf, Ptpn5, and Atp2a2, whereas Spred2 did not significantly affect that module and also showed weak self-RNA depletion. This suggests the expected SPRED2-NF1 Ras/ERK program was not transcriptionally released in this cell type, while leaving open possible nontranscriptional signaling changes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Cry1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a sparse, distinctive response in which Per2 was the sole FDR-significant hit, and this pattern was not reproduced by related clock perturbations. In the same cell type, Cry2 instead decreased Nr1d1 and Dbp without significant Per2 induction, while Bmal1 and Clock drove stronger repression of canonical clock outputs including Dbp, Nr1d2, Nr1d1, and Tef. Whole-signature correlations were near zero across these targets, so the divergence is defined by selected circadian output genes rather than a strong transcriptome-wide opposition.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Cnot1 in 155 MB Glut showed only weak whole-signature similarity to TSC/proteasome and vacuolar biology perturbations, with the closest positive neighbors being Tsc1 (r=0.21) and Psmb4 or Pomp (r=0.20), alongside Tsc2, Psmc1, and Psmc5, and no strong anticorrelated neighbor. This was the only cell class with significant Cnot1-regulated genes, featuring a four-gene downregulated response led by Pcsk1n and lacking TNRC6 convergence. The pattern is therefore exploratory rather than a close phenocopy, and the proteasome/TSC1-TSC2 enrichment came from post hoc STRING analysis of top neighbors.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Med23 in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut thalamic cell class showed only partial convergence with other Mediator perturbations: it shared a downregulated neuronal module and FDR-level genes with Med15 and Med13, but had near-zero whole-signature similarity and no shared FDR genes with Cdk8 or Med12, despite substantial perturbed-cell counts. The affected program included synaptic and glutamatergic genes such as Grm1, Grin2b, Lrrtm1, Atp2b1, Atp2a2, and Prkcd. Because whole-transcriptome correlations were small, the convergence rests mainly on the shared FDR tail, indicating that Mediator membership alone did not predict interchangeable neuronal phenotypes in this state.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba
full_finding_text: Thoc1 perturbation showed positive signature convergence with nuclear mRNA export and splicing perturbations rather than an unrelated or opposite signature family, especially in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 052 Pvalb Gaba. Its nearest positive neighbors repeatedly included Tpr, Snrnp70, U2af2, Cdc40, Ddx39b, and Thoc2, consistent with THO/TREX-mediated mature mRNA export and RNA splicing pathways; in 191 MB P MY GABA, Nxf1 was specifically repressed. However, the strongest correlations were modest transcriptome-wide score correlations, strongest negative neighbors were weak, and proteasome neighbors such as Psmc1 and Psmb4 may reflect secondary stress.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Gsk3b in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a thalamic perturbation signature that, when restricted to its 50 strongest responsive genes, aligned most strongly in the same direction with Tsc2 and Tsc1 and in the opposite direction with Mtor, placing the neuronal RNA output closest to a TSC/mTOR signaling module. This was the only Gsk3b contrast with an FDR-resolved non-target signature, but the convergence was driven by the top-gene subset and all-gene Pearson correlations were only modest.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Nr1d1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells showed a restricted 116-gene response whose nearest positive neighbors were Nr1d2 and Bmal1, with Clock weaker but still positive, while Rora was partly opposed and Cry1/Cry2 were only weak neighbors. This pattern recapitulates expected Rev-erb paralog and ROR/Rev-erb antagonism, yet also reveals an unexpected broad convergence between Bmal1 and Nr1d1 perturbations despite their canonical placement on opposite sides of the Bmal1–Nr1d1 feedback loop. Because correlations were computed only over Nr1d1-selected genes, this should be read as a neighbor screen rather than an unbiased genome-wide phenocopy.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: E2f5 did not phenocopy the E2F/RB module in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: unlike E2f4, Rb1, and Tfdp1, which showed FDR-significant DREAM/RB-E2F G1/S cell-cycle transcription responses, E2f5 had no FDR-significant hits despite 117 perturbed cells, and its score correlations to E2f4- and Rb1-associated signatures were near zero. In this thalamic glutamatergic context, related perturbations implicated genes such as Aaas, Rad18, Tacc3, Tube1, Dnmt1, Tipin, Prim1, Lig1, Mcm2, Mcm6, Cntrob, and Dcaf15, but E2f5 did not. Interpretation is tempered because cross-perturbation cell counts differed and E2f5 knockdown was not validated at the transcript level.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Shoc2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic thalamic neurons shows an RNA state weighted toward Braf and Map2k1 rather than Raf1 or Map2k2. In this cell type, Braf and Map2k1 each produced four FDR-significant genes and shared Vgf and Unc13a downregulation with Shoc2, whereas Raf1 and Map2k2 produced no FDR-significant genes and showed much weaker correlation to the Shoc2 signature. Within RTK/RAS/SHOC2-PP1/RAF/MEK/ERK signaling, Shoc2 loss aligns with Braf and Map2k1 loss and opposes Nf1 loss, although this comparison is limited to one cell type and RNA signatures rather than direct RAF isoform activity.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: E2f1 showed a weak or flat transcriptional profile and did not induce the E2F/RB G1-S DNA-replication module that was observed with E2f4 or Rb1 in multiple neuronal subclasses. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, E2f4 strongly increased Aaas, Rad18, Tacc3, and Tube1, while Rb1 increased Dnmt1, Tipin, Prim1, and Lig1; E2f1 was essentially uncorrelated with these signatures in the same cells. Similar E2f4 or Rb1, but not E2f1, induction was seen in 155 MB Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, and 191 MB P MY GABA, with the caveat that comparator perturbations also showed weak target-transcript knockdown, so the contrast is based on observed transcriptomic signatures rather than validated protein loss.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Gabra2 showed a weak, perturbation-specific response rather than a pathway-wide failure of GABA-A receptor perturbations. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, Gabra2 had nominal on-target depletion but no corrected self-depletion despite the largest matched perturbed-cell count, whereas Gabrb2, Gabrg2, Gabra1, Gabrd, and Gabrb3 showed strong own-transcript depletion in overlapping contrasts. This supports a technical or quantitative interpretation within GABA-A receptor activation and chloride-channel gating, not a direct biological opposition between subunits, and it reflects transcript knockdown rather than matched electrophysiology.

Npy2r was uncoupled from the expected inhibitory cAMP and melanocortin appetite neighborhoods at the transcriptome level: perturbation signatures for Adcy1, Adcy3, Adcy5, Agrp, Mc3r, and Mc4r were neither similar nor opposite to Npy2r, and the nearest positive and negative neighbors to Npy2r were only weakly related. This included a negative result in the 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut class, even though Adcy3 itself was robustly depleted in some cell types. The interpretation is limited because these correlations come from broad cell-class mRNA profiles, so acute GPCR signaling may occur without shifting ranked transcriptional signatures.

Mrtfa showed essentially no meaningful score-vector convergence or opposition with actin-family perturbations (Actb, Actg1, Actn4), TGF-beta/BMP receptor perturbations (Tgfbr1, Tgfbr2, Acvr1, Acvr2a, Acvr2b), or the top genome-scale nearest neighbors such as Fbxo11 and Fxr1. In this dataset, the weak Mrtfa signature therefore did not phenocopy an actin-regulatory, receptor-neighbor, or global neighbor program. This should be read as absence of detectable phenocopy in these data, not pathway independence in vivo, since SRF and Mrtfb were not perturbation targets and correlations were computed on already-weak signatures.

Naa10 showed no transcriptional alignment with Mtor, Tsc1, or Tsc2 perturbation signatures, and genome-wide differential-expression testing did not resolve a downstream Naa10 response in any cell type. Thus, this screen does not recover the curated NAA10–TSC2–mTOR mechanism at the transcriptome level, and mTOR-direction hypotheses should not be inferred from the weak Naa10 signal. Because the comparison is based on signature correlation and Naa10 itself lacks a strong DE signature, these data do not rule out NAA10 regulation of TSC2 protein acetylation or stability.

Rptor showed a weak but directionally coherent signature in the whole-dataset neighbor scan: Mtor fell on the same side as Rptor, whereas Tsc1 and Tsc2 were the strongest negative mTOR-axis neighbors, consistent with TSC-RHEB regulation of mTORC1 in which TSC1/2 loss opposes RPTOR or MTOR loss. This pattern was observed as a rank-based directional signal rather than a strong transcriptome-wide match, because the absolute correlations were very small (|r| < 0.05), and it was derived from mixed neuronal classes rather than direct pathway activity measurements.

cell_types: 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut
full_finding_text: Gnal showed only weak and mixed transcriptomic relationships to curated Gαolf–adenylyl-cyclase–cAMP pathway neighbors, most clearly in 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut, the only FDR-positive cell class. In that class, Gnal was weakly similar to Adora2a, Gnas, and Gnb1, but weakly anti-correlated with Adcy5 and Adcy1, while core pathway genes were not FDR-significant and Pde4a was only nominally increased. Across 43,663 cross-perturbation comparisons, the strongest Gnal neighbor reached only Pearson r=0.160, consistent with a weak, indirect readout of pathway activity and limited target engagement for many comparators.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Ptch2 showed its clearest but still modest signature-neighbor structure in 308 CB GABA cells: despite having no significant differential-expression genes in this class, its full-transcriptome profile was weakly anticorrelated with B9d1, a ciliary transition-zone Hedgehog regulator, and positively related to perturbations such as Zic3, Cckar, and Wdr26. The effect was limited to this cell type, with the largest absolute correlation only 0.254, so the pattern is best treated as an exploratory hint of ciliary/Hedgehog coupling rather than a confirmed module.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Bmal2 was buffered and diverged from related clock perturbations in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons: despite 182 perturbed cells, it produced no adjusted hits and did not appreciably shift the circadian E-box/transcription-translation feedback loop genes Dbp, Nr1d1, Nr1d2, Tef, Per3, Npas2, Adgrb1, or Erc2. In the same cell class, Bmal1, Clock, Nr1d1, and Rora elicited strong supported programs, and perturbome-wide neighbor searches showed little convergence with Bmal2. A caveat is that the Bmal2 contrast lacked clear Arntl2 transcript depletion, so the divergence may reflect both biology and weaker perturbation efficiency.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Bdp1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut diverged from the only available Pol III neighbor, Polr3b, despite both lying in the RNA polymerase III/TFIIIB system. Each perturbation had 8 FDR-significant genes, but there was no overlap and the matched-gene correlation was low (r=0.156). Bdp1 was associated with a Ddit3 and aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase program, including Mars1, Aars, Cars, Iars, Lars, and Yars, suggesting this response is not a generic consequence of Pol III disruption. This contrast is tempered by weak target knockdown for both genes and by the fact that the comparison is transcriptomic rather than a direct Pol III activity assay.

Gabrg3 showed a weak Perturb-seq signature that did not converge with better-engaged GABA-A receptor perturbations. Across matched cell types, Gabrg3 scores were near zero in similarity to Gabrg2, Gabrd, Gabra1, Gabrb2, and Slc6a1, and there was no detectable downstream response in the GABA receptor activation context. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Gabrg3 showed no on-target depletion while Gabrg2, Gabrb2, and Gabrd were strongly depleted; in 155 MB Glut, Gabrg3 showed only nominal reduction whereas Gabrg2 was robustly depleted. This pattern supports non-convergence rather than opposite biology.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Abcc9 showed its only visible signature neighborhood in 308 CB GABA, where its residual vector was weakly correlated with Wdr26 and Cckar and anti-correlated with B9d1 and Ranbp2, with Pearson |r| around 0.24. However, Abcc9 itself had no FDR-significant genes, a Safe_target_70 signature also appeared among the anti-neighbors, and Wdr26 and Ranbp2 had much stronger corrected signatures than Abcc9. Overall, this pattern appears exploratory and more consistent with a shared cerebellar CB GABA state axis than with validated ABCC9-specific KATP biology.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Tanc2 showed its strongest whole-signature neighbors in 308 CB GABA, with positive similarity to Wdr26, Ranbp2, and Atp6v1e1 and negative similarity to Cckar and Msx2, but this pattern arose in a no-engagement context: measured Tanc2 knockdown was essentially absent in that cell type and there were no FDR-significant differentially expressed genes. Thus, these visually strong z-score-vector correlations are poor evidence for a Tanc2 pathway and are better treated as a warning about signature-neighbor mining when the on-target perturbation signal is missing.

Hoxd13 showed little convergence with related HOX-family and PBX/MEIS perturbations: across the 22 assayed Hoxd13 brain cell types, score-vector correlations with Hoxa13, Hoxc13, Hoxd10, Hoxa1, Hoxa3, Hoxb8, Meis1, Meis2, Pbx1, and Pbx3 stayed near zero, and the strongest genome-wide signature neighbor reached only r = 0.130. Thus, in this dataset these developmental factors were not interchangeable and the Hoxd13 profile lacked a clear HOX13 core response, although the Hoxd13 signature itself was weak, so this negative convergence should not be read as antagonistic biology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Rb1 preferentially exposed a G1/S DNA-replication program, while E2f4 triggered a related but non-identical cell-cycle response in overlapping neuronal classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 191 MB P MY GABA. In the strongest shared classes, the Rb1-up and E2f4-up FDR gene sets showed zero overlap, with E2f4-associated genes such as Aaas, Rad18, Tacc3, Tube1, Blm, Ddx11, and Polq suggesting a distinct DREAM-like module. Smaller concordant Rb1 replication-marker responses recurred in midbrain glutamatergic and Pvalb GABAergic cells, but Rbl1 and Rbl2 were not perturbed, limiting comparison to E2f4 rather than the full p107/p130-DREAM arm.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Armc9 showed a nonconvergent, generally weak transcriptomic response in this neuronal Perturb-seq dataset, so it did not align with available primary cilium/Joubert ciliopathy perturbations. In 155 MB Glut, Ahi1 and Cplane1 showed FDR-significant self-depletion whereas Armc9 did not, and in 308 CB GABA the strongest related family signal, from B9d1, was only weakly anticorrelated with Armc9. Across the broader set of ciliary genes, including Bbs5, Ift88, Cspp1, and Gli2, family responses were sparse, and the closest reported ARMC9 partners such as TOGARAM1, CEP104, and CCDC66 were not targeted here.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Specc1l did not show a robust, interpretable convergence partner in signature-neighbor scans. The largest, but still modest, correlations were confined to 308 CB GABA, where Wdr26 and Dstyk showed weak similarity and B9d1 and Ranbp2 showed opposition. However, Specc1l itself was not nominally depleted in 308 CB GABA, and a Safe_target perturbation appeared among anti-neighbors, so these patterns remain exploratory and do not support elevating Wdr26 or Dstyk as mechanistic Specc1l partners from this dataset alone.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA
full_finding_text: Twist1 was largely inactive across the profiled neuronal cell types, with no robust Twist1-like or Twist1-opposing transcriptomic module detected. In contrast, related EMT-family perturbations diverged: Zeb1 showed restricted FDR-significant signatures in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, while Zeb2 was active in 052 Pvalb Gaba; Twist2, Snai2, Tcf3, and Tcf12 were essentially null, and Tcf4 showed only a small Pvalb response. Thus, in these neurons, EMT-family membership did not predict interchangeability, though comparator differences could reflect guide efficacy, on-target expression, and DE-based rather than protein-activity readouts.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Tbcd perturbation produced a Tuba1a/Tuba1b-up signature that converged with Tbce, especially in 155 MB Glut and also in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 191 MB P MY GABA. In contrast, perturbing Tuba1a, Tubb3, Tubb5, Stmn2, Map1b, or Kif1a did not recreate this cofactor-like program; in 155 MB Glut those perturbations mainly depleted their own target transcript. The pattern is consistent with a post-chaperonin tubulin-folding/heterodimer-assembly bottleneck, although Tbcd-Tbce whole-signature correlations were small, so the convergence is focused rather than transcriptome-wide.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Kcnb1 in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut showed a restricted signature-neighbor split rather than a single shared direction across comparator perturbations: Grin2a, Arhgef9, Gabrb3, Kcnq2, Gabrg2, and Scn2a were Kcnb1-like, whereas Grin2b, Ank3, Syngap1, Shank2, Camk2a, and Kcnd3 were Kcnb1-opposing. This exploratory analysis used only Kcnb1’s top 100 genes in one cell type, where Kcnb1 also linked to the Bdnf/Vgf/Nptx2 pattern, and some correlated comparators, including Kcnq2, had few or no FDR-significant downstream genes.

Prr12 showed signatures that were mostly orthogonal to cohesin-loader, cohesin-ring, and neurodevelopmental chromatin perturbations: across overlapping Prr12 cell types, whole-transcriptome score correlations with Nipbl, Smc1a, Smc3, Stag1, Stag2, Pds5a, Chd8, Arid1a, and Kmt2e were near zero. A weak convergence was seen only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, while stronger apparent neighbor structure occurred in a class without target engagement. These data argue against treating PRR12 as interchangeable with core cohesin loss in mature neurons, although transcript-based correlations may miss effects mediated through chromatin architecture, genome integrity, or cell-cycle state.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ctnnb1 in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut class showed the expected canonical Wnt-directional relationships: Apc opposed the Ctnnb1 signature, while Lrp6 and Tcf7l2 aligned positively with it on the restricted 151 signature. Ctnnb1 loss suppressed Wnt-feedback genes including Axin2, Notum, and Lef1, and Apc reversed multiple Wnt sentinel genes, whereas Lrp6 and Tcf7l2 were among the closest positive neighbors. This convergence is qualified by the ranking being based on the top 1000 Ctnnb1 absolute-score genes, and by Lrp6 having only four FDR-significant genes, indicating a restricted-signature convergence rather than broad overlap.

cell_types: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Bcl2 showed no robust transcriptional convergence or opposition in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut: across 44,110 non-self perturbation signatures, its strongest positive neighbor was only Fgfr2 (r=0.176) and its strongest negative neighbor was Syn1 (r=-0.158). Available apoptosis/survival-related perturbations Xiap, Nfkb1, and Nfkb2 also remained weakly correlated with Bcl2 (all |r|<0.087), suggesting Bcl2 did not sit in a detectable recurrent module in this library, although this inference is limited because core BCL2-family interactors such as Bax, Bad, Bbc3, Bcl2l1, Bcl2l11, Bnip3, and Pmaip1 were not perturbed.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Uqcrfs1 in 155 MB Glut showed strong on-target transcript depletion but little downstream convergence with other mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III perturbations. Although Uqcrc1, Uqcrc2, Cyc1, and Ttc19 also significantly depleted their own transcripts in the same cell class, Uqcrfs1 score-vector correlations with these and nearby subunits such as Uqcrq, Uqcc2, Uqcrb, and Uqcrh were near zero, and Ttc19 was not induced. This cell-type-restricted result suggests that shared complex membership did not produce a common neuronal mRNA signature here, while low correlations likely reflect sparse downstream responses rather than opposite biochemical effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Chd4 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed an opposing transcriptomic neighborhood to several BAF/PBAF chromatin-remodeler perturbations: Smarcb1, Arid1a, Arid2, Smarcc2, and Smarce1 were among the strongest negative Chd4 neighbors, forming a coherent Chd4-opposed signature. This suggests that closely related chromatin-disease genes can diverge in the same neuronal class, so downstream readouts from a NuRD perturbation should not be assumed to phenocopy BAF-family loss. However, the anti-correlations were small in absolute magnitude, reflect rank-based signature neighborhoods, and need direct enhancer or chromatin data for mechanism.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Smc3 showed a selective and relatively weak transcriptomic context in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: Nipbl, Smc1a, and Stag2 were its nearest positive neighbors, whereas Ctcf, Hdac8, Pds5a, and Stag1 had near-zero correlations and did not phenocopy Smc3. In the same cell type, Ctcf, Nipbl, Smc1a, and Stag2 yielded many FDR-significant genes, while Smc3 yielded none, indicating that cohesin loading, SMC3 acetylation-cycle, and CTCF-associated genome-folding perturbations were not interchangeable in this readout. This interpretation is limited by untested cohesin regulators and by reliance on transcriptome-rank similarity rather than direct chromatin phenotypes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: E2f4 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons produced a significant but partial E2F module rather than a full canonical G1/S E2F-RB program: the strongest response was dominated by up-regulated mitotic, centromere, and DNA-repair genes, while classic E2F4/DREAM targets such as Mybl2, Cdk1, Ccna2, Mcm2, and Pcna were not FDR-significant. In the same neurons, Rb1 perturbation induced Dnmt1, Tipin, Prim1, Mcm2, E2f1, Ccne2, and Pcna, suggesting an E2f4-linked mitotic/repair arm distinct from a broader Rb1 S-phase arm, with gene detection and neuronal state potentially masking some canonical targets.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Mtor showed only modest RNA signatures, but in the more responsive classes its loss signature was opposite to perturbations of upstream mTORC1 repressors. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Tsc1, Tsc2, Pten, and Depdc5 were the strongest negative neighbors of Mtor, and Tsc1/Tsc2 with or without Pten also ranked as the top negative neighbors in 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. This link was based on weak-to-moderate RNA correlations, and several Mtor cell classes were too weak to show the pattern.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|054 CNU-MGE GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Clock perturbation showed a reciprocal relationship with Nr1d2 across several cell types, consistent with a REV-ERB/ROR secondary circadian feedback arm. In 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Clock loss strongly repressed Nr1d2 together with Dbp and Tef, while Nr1d2 loss shifted Nr1d1 and often Dbp in the opposite direction; similar Nr1d1 induction recurred in 054 CNU-MGE GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. Clock also nominally induced Arntl in midbrain glutamatergic cells. Most Nr1d2-induced genes outside 151 TH were nominal rather than FDR-significant, and the assay captures short-term mRNA changes rather than full circadian dynamics.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Ap3b1 did not behave like the neuronal AP-3 beta paralog Ap3b2 in this dataset. Across 18 shared cell classes, Ap3b1–Ap3b2 score correlations were near zero, while Ap3b2 showed significant self-repression in four classes—005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and 155 MB Glut—without FDR-supported non-target transcript changes. Ap3b1 perturbation was weak, with no FDR-supported Ap3b1 mRNA response, so the lack of correlation does not establish true AP3B1/AP3B2 opposition within AP-3 adaptor/Golgi-associated vesicle biogenesis.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Cckar showed its only reproducible-looking nominal profile in 308 CB GABA, where the restricted signature was more Wdr26-like and opposite to Ranbp2 than it was similar to Cck or Cckbr. This places the clearest subthreshold Cckar state along an exploratory off-axis relationship, with genes such as Efr3b, Sh2d5, Unc5c, Syn2, and Snph appearing in the cell-type context. Because this comparison is correlation-based over a subthreshold profile, it does not establish a mechanistic connection between Cckar and Wdr26 or Ranbp2.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Atxn7 was largely silent in this brain Perturb-seq screen, diverging sharply from the SAGA-associated interactor Trrap. Across 20 shared cell groups, Trrap perturbation produced 726 FDR-significant gene-by-cell-type effects, including 455 genes in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, whereas Atxn7 produced none, and their signatures were essentially uncorrelated in shared contexts such as 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA. This contrast suggests that shared membership in the SAGA/STAGA chromatin complex does not imply interchangeable perturbation signatures here, with the caveat that Trrap has broader chromatin roles and the core USP22-ATXN7L3-ENY2 deubiquitinase module was not directly perturbed.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Adnp was not interchangeable with all chromatin-remodeler perturbations in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons. In this primary Adnp-sensitive class, where 25 genes were FDR-significant, Chd4 showed the closest non-self convergence, whereas Arid2 was the most anti-correlated perturbation genome-wide, with only 7 of 25 Adnp-significant genes changing in the same direction. Together with a similar Adnp–Chd4 neighborhood across two cell types, this points to a ChAHP/CHD4-associated chromatin-regulation state rather than a generic SWI/SNF-like loss, although the Arid2 contrast is transcriptomic and does not demonstrate direct antagonism.

Fbxw7 showed no strong convergence or opposition with any assayed perturbation: across unrestricted neighbor analysis, all non-self correlations with the Fbxw7 signature stayed near zero and never exceeded |r|=0.035, including the related F-box/cullin genes Fbxo11 and Cul3. Perturbations of assayed NOTCH, MYC, and SREBP pathway neighbors were likewise essentially uncorrelated, suggesting transcript-level uncoupling within the SCF-FBXW7 ubiquitin-proteasome and NOTCH-MYC substrate-control context. This negative result is limited by the sparse primary Fbxw7 signature and by comparisons being restricted to assayed targets.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ap1b1 showed a divergent, buffered transcriptional phenotype relative to related coat perturbations. In 155 MB Glut, Ap1b1 knockdown produced strong on-target mRNA repression but no additional FDR-significant trans genes, whereas Cltc knockdown in the same cell type triggered a broad 41-gene response. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ap1b1 likewise remained target-only and showed only weak similarity to Ap1s2 and Vps35 perturbations. This comparison is tempered by the fact that Cltc is a global coat component and Ap1s2 had weak measured target engagement.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Ednra perturbation did not recover the expected endothelin receptor to Gαq/phospholipase-C beta signaling program in endpoint transcriptomes. In 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, Plcb1 showed detectable self-knockdown, yet Ednra and Plcb1 signatures remained uncoupled, and across 20 shared neuronal classes the Ednra score vectors were essentially uncorrelated with Plcb1 perturbation scores. No other perturbation produced a strong whole-transcriptome match to Ednra, suggesting no durable PLCβ/Ca2+/PKC transcriptional state was detected, although acute calcium signaling may be missed and Plcb1 is only one component of the Gαq pathway.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut
full_finding_text: Cr2 diverged from Cd81 in neuronal Perturb-seq despite their canonical B-cell coreceptor relationship. In 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut, the only class with a Cr2 FDR hit, Cr2 perturbation was associated with decreased Map1lc3a in 24 perturbed cells, but Cd81 was efficiently depleted in the same class without changing Map1lc3a, and the full Cr2 and Cd81 signatures were nearly uncorrelated. Across all 21 shared neuronal classes, Cr2–Cd81 correlations were weak, refining this interaction to a neuronal context rather than disproving the biochemical complex, especially since Cd19 was not perturbed and Cd81 has CR2-independent roles.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Fbxo11 in 308 CB GABA showed the largest nominal signature but no FDR-significant genes, based on only 29 perturbed cells. Within this restricted signature, the overlap with Wdr26 was entirely sign-opposed: across 16,945 genes, Fbxo11 and Wdr26 had Pearson r = -0.508, and 192 genes that were nominal for Fbxo11 and FDR-significant for Wdr26 all changed in the opposite direction. This suggests an exploratory, antagonistic Cb GABA state relative to Wdr26 rather than a generic weak-perturbation artifact, but it requires replication.

Lbx1 showed no detectable convergence or opposition with its developmental neighbors Tlx3 and Phox2b in this brain Perturb-seq screen. Across the assayed broad brain classes, Tlx3 and Phox2b perturbations were also near-null, and a restricted analysis using the 50 most extreme Lbx1 genes per cell type yielded only very small aggregate correlations, with no strong or interpretable signature neighbor. This suggests the LBX1–TLX3 transmitter-fate and LBX1–PHOX2B respiratory-neuron developmental programs were not coherently engaged here, especially in 191 MB P MY GABA, 308 CB GABA, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut, though comparator perturbations also lacked target-transcript depletion.

Hes7 showed no strong transcriptomic convergence or opposition with any perturbation in the assayed panel: the strongest non-self correlation in the whole-panel neighbor scan was only |r| = 0.214. Top neighbors included Mcph1 and, in some cell types, Safe_target_72 and Safe_target_73, which argues that the muted Hes7 result is not simply embedded in a reproducible related off-target module. This conclusion is tempered by the fact that correlations were computed from Wilcoxon score vectors and may miss small nonlinear or subpopulation-specific effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Pdgfrb showed no FDR-significant downstream genes across all 22 Pdgfrb-assayed neuronal subclasses, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, whereas the comparator Pten produced a detectable PI3K-adjacent transcriptional response with 45 FDR-significant genes overall and 33 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. This pattern suggests receptor-layer uncoupling of PDGFRB in these neuronal cells rather than complete invisibility of intracellular growth-factor signaling, although PTEN is an intracellular PI3K brake rather than a PDGFRB-complex member, so the pathway localization remains coarse.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Atrx recurrently repressed Csf2ra, with nominal decreases in 14 of 18 cell types and FDR-significant downregulation in the two strongest contexts, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut. In those same two classes, Chd8 induced Csf2ra, making the direction opposite to Atrx rather than a generic chromatin-perturbation effect. In 155 MB Glut, Csf2ra was the only FDR-significant Atrx-responsive gene. Csf2ra therefore serves as a directionally specific transcriptomic sentinel, although these data do not establish GM-CSF receptor signaling or direct chromatin binding.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Grm8 diverged from the related group-III receptor Grm7 in the atlas, especially in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells. In that class, Grm7 showed significant self-depletion, whereas Grm8 did not, and the whole-atlas Grm8-versus-Grm7 transcriptomic signatures were essentially uncorrelated. This suggests Grm8 silencing is not interchangeable with Grm7 in these data, although the contrast may mainly reflect sgRNA efficacy or transcript detectability rather than opposite receptor physiology.

cell_types: 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|022 L5 ET CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Kbtbd7 showed only a weak, cell-type-specific inverse relationship with Rac1: in top-200-gene restricted signatures, Rac1 knockdown was an inverse neighbor in 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA and 022 L5 ET CTX Glut, which is directionally compatible with a KBTBD7-loss to RAC1-gain model in the CUL3(KBTBD6/KBTBD7)-GABARAP-TIAM1-RAC1 pathway. However, this signal was limited to the restricted metric, all-gene correlations in the same classes were near zero, and Kbtbd7 signatures were not FDR-significant, with little broader tracking to Cul3, Tiam1, Cdc42, or autophagy-adjacent perturbations.

Clpp showed an essentially orthogonal transcriptomic signature to its ClpXP partner Clpx in this screen, with near-zero genome-wide correlation despite both genes belonging to mitochondrial matrix ClpXP proteolysis. In 052 Pvalb Gaba cells, both perturbations showed some nominal target-transcript depletion, but neither produced FDR-significant downstream genes. This suggests Clpp and Clpx should not be treated as interchangeable here, although the weak, buffered loss-of-function signatures mean the near-zero correlation could reflect low perturbation efficiency rather than a true mechanistic divergence.

Aebp1 showed no robust positive or negative signature neighbor in Glut/GABA neuronal classes. Across 14 glutamatergic and 8 GABAergic groups, the Aebp1 perturbation lacked coherent genome-wide differential expression, collagen/ECM changes, and recognizable neighbor structure; cosine comparisons using full Wilcoxon-score vectors restricted to shared cell types produced only weak matches, with the top positives including Camta1, Manf, L1cam, Safe_target_81, Msx2, Zeb2, and Scn9a, but maxima and minima remained small. Because the Aebp1 vectors had no FDR-significant hits, these ranks are best treated as exploratory and noise-like rather than pathway convergence or opposition.

Gfm2 showed no meaningful transcriptome-wide signature neighbor in the 2,046-target screen: no other perturbation displayed strong positive similarity or strong opposition, and the strongest absolute correlation of Wilcoxon score vectors across shared measured genes and cell types was only 0.036. This suggests the negative phenotype was not simply hidden as an anti-correlated or convergent module resembling another perturbation, although very low-coverage perturbations can yield unstable small correlations.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Crebbp perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a modest up-regulated nuclear branch in which Ddx17 and Srcap, along with Srsf11, increased slightly within a mixed downstream response tied to KAT3/CBP transcriptional coactivation. This pattern may reflect feedback onto CBP-associated RNA/chromatin machinery, but the signal was near the FDR 0.05 threshold and the dataset measures transcript abundance only, not CBP complex assembly, binding, or acetylation; in the same cell type, Ep300 diverged and weak Kmt2d/Kdm6a/Trrap convergence was also noted.

cell_types: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Dpyd showed no robust same-cell signature neighbor in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut. Its strongest positive correlation was only with Zbtb21 (r=0.183) and its strongest negative with Fgfr2 (r=-0.182), while the biologically adjacent perturbations Abat and the noncanonical dihydropyrimidinase-like Dpysl5 were essentially uncorrelated. Because these comparisons were based on DE score vectors rather than raw single-cell profiles, and even the top absolute correlations were below 0.19, the weak Dpyd signature did not support assignment to any broader convergent pathway module.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chrnb2 perturbation showed a cell-type-specific and non-interchangeable transcriptomic pattern relative to Chrna4. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, Chrnb2 knockdown caused FDR-significant self-depletion but no FDR-significant non-target genes, whereas Chrna4 knockdown in the same class produced an FDR-significant decrease in Cyp46a1. Conversely, Chrnb2 was FDR-depleted in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, where the Chrna4 self-row was weak, and across these classes there was no broad beta2-containing nicotinic receptor signaling response; differential guide efficiency and low expression may contribute.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Appl1 showed only a restricted, exploratory PI3K-AKT-TSC/mTOR signal in cerebellar GABAergic cells: in 308 CB GABA, its genome-wide score profile correlated with Akt3 and anticorrelated with Tsc2. This sign is compatible with APPL1 acting upstream of AKT and opposite the AKT-inhibited TSC2 brake on mTOR, but the effect was weak and cell-type-specific. A key caveat is that Appl1 itself was not depleted in 308 CB GABA, and the comparison relies on score correlations rather than significant Appl1 marker genes.

cell_types: 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Cdin1 showed only weak, mixed signature-neighbor relationships in the two most nominally responsive cell types, 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut and 022 L5 ET CTX Glut. In restricted scans using the 200 largest-magnitude Cdin1 genes, top Pearson correlations were only moderate in 009 and weak in 022, and no biologically interpretable CDIN1-like pathway neighbor emerged; instead, neighbors included Mc2r, Tubb3, Trpm3, Ddx23, Gnb5, Clip2, and even Safe_target_43, Safe_target_13, and Safe_target_24 in same- or opposite-direction positions. These exploratory results, together with the lack of direct Codanin-1/ASF1-family comparators, argue that the nominal Cdin1 signatures are fragile and should not be over-interpreted as mechanistic convergence.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Cplx2 diverged from its paralog Cplx1 at the transcript-level engagement step: unlike Cplx1, which was robustly depleted across multiple groups including 052 Pvalb Gaba and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Cplx2 was not significantly depleted in those same contexts despite similar or larger Cplx2 cell numbers. In SNARE-dependent synaptic vesicle exocytosis, Cplx2 also lacked strong positive or negative transcriptomic neighbors, and Cplx1–Cplx2 whole-signature correlations stayed near zero, suggesting weak engagement or an isoform/readout mismatch rather than a Cplx1-like synaptic perturbation; however, these comparisons rely on target-mRNA depletion and transcriptome correlations and do not exclude Cplx2 protein editing.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ebf2 was inert in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: despite having the largest Ebf2-targeted cell count, it produced no FDR-significant genes, indicating a buffered downstream response. In the same cell type, the Wnt effector Ctnnb1 was strongly active, yielding 383 FDR<0.05 genes, so the assay could detect this pathway. This contrast uncouples Ebf2 from a published EBF2/LEF1/β-catenin relationship and suggests the null Ebf2 result is target- and context-specific, with the prior mechanism measured at the Opg promoter in osteoblasts rather than thalamic glutamatergic neurons.

Kcnq5 showed a weak, divergent RNA signature that was essentially uncorrelated with Kcnq1, Kcnq2, and Kcnq3, despite their shared Kv7/KCNQ M-current channel context. In the same assay, Kcnq2 achieved much stronger on-target transcript depletion in many overlapping classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, where Kcnq2 was strongly depleted while Kcnq5 was not. Thus, the dataset does not support using Kcnq2 or Kcnq3 transcriptomic responses as surrogates for Kcnq5 loss, although this conclusion is limited by weak Kcnq5 target engagement and reflects RNA-signature divergence rather than proof of biological inactivity.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Mga perturbation was associated with Stag3 upregulation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, and Max converged on this response, with Obscn also shared in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. In contrast, Mnt, Myc, Mycn, E2f1, E2f4, E2f5, Tfdp1, and Tfdp2 did not reproduce the Stag3 increase in these cell classes, pointing to the MAX/MGA repressive branch rather than a generic MAX-network effect. This pattern is consistent with release of MAX/MGA-ncPRC1.6 repression of ectopic germline or meiotic genes, although Pcgf6, L3mbtl2, and E2f6 were not perturbed and the assayed E2Fs are imperfect substitutes for E2F6.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Adcy5 showed its best nominal self-reduction in the 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA cell class, where Adcy2 also rose nominally in the opposite direction, suggesting a possible adenylyl-cyclase paralog compensation within the membrane adenylyl-cyclase module that includes Adcy1, Adcy2, Adcy3, and Adcy5. However, both signals were only nominal and not FDR-significant, so this remains exploratory. This pattern is broadly consistent with Adcy5-null mouse observations of small increases in other cyclase isoforms, but it does not establish Adcy2 specifically as the compensating isoform in this cell class.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Csnk2b showed no strong convergence or opposition with any assayed perturbation across the main responding cell types, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. The nearest same-direction DE-score neighbor in any FDR-positive Csnk2b cell type was weak, with Pearson r only 0.188, and candidates such as Neurod2, Ank3, Slc7a6os, Tsc1, Esrra, and Wdr26 did not provide a compelling phenocopy. Because Csnk2a1 and Csnk2a2 were not included in the library, direct CK2 catalytic-subunit comparisons were not possible, and these conclusions rest on DE-score correlations rather than independent single-cell embeddings or protein-level readouts.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Itpr1 in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut did not show transcriptomic mimicry with its canonical upstream pathway neighbor Plcb1: each perturbation produced only its own transcript as the sole FDR-significant hit, and their full Wilcoxon-score signatures were essentially uncorrelated. Thus, within this cell type, the PLCβ → IP3 → ITPR step did not yield a shared mRNA output in this Perturb-seq readout. This negative comparison is limited to one cell class and to transcript-level signatures, and Plcb1 versus Itpr1 depletion may engage different subcellular signaling contexts.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|053 Sst Gaba
full_finding_text: Prkaca knockdown did not produce an inverse transcriptome to Prkar1a knockdown, even though they encode antagonistic catalytic and regulatory arms of the cAMP/PKA signaling pathway. In responsive overlapping classes, especially 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, both perturbations were largely self-only where they engaged, and their score vectors were nearly uncorrelated rather than opposite. Despite strong on-target depletion, the dataset did not detect a recurrent FDR-controlled downstream mRNA program, consistent with buffering of core holoenzyme dosage; however, Prkar1a guide cell counts were smaller, and the comparison is based on score-vector correlations rather than matched phospho-PKA measurements.

Bcl11a showed a weak perturbation phenotype, and its paralog Bcl11b converged only in that weakness rather than in a reproducible shared transcriptional signature. Across the sampled brain cell types, global scans found no multiple-testing-significant differential expression for Bcl11a, and Bcl11b had 0 FDR hits in 388,046 rows. Using only the top 200 Bcl11a-scored genes per cell type, restricted signature correlations did not recover Bcl11b as a close same- or opposite-direction neighbor, so the dataset does not support a strong interchangeable acute signature for these BAF-associated factors.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Dcaf8 in 155 MB Glut showed only a target-transcript decrease, with buffered non-target mRNA responses and no strong positive or negative transcriptomic neighbor. Available DCAF-related perturbations did not phenocopy this signature: Ddb2 and Dcaf17 were essentially uncorrelated with Dcaf8, and the strongest unbiased neighbors among other perturbations, including Msl2 and Sec31a, all had |r|<0.1. Thus, within the CUL4-DDB1/CRL4 DCAF ubiquitin ligase context, Dcaf8 behaves as a weak, target-specific perturbation rather than a shared module, although core DDB1/CUL4/RBX components and DCAF8-like paralogs were not tested.

cell_types: 145 MH-LH TH Glut
full_finding_text: Irf2bpl in 145 MH-LH TH Glut showed its strongest nominal response with Zdhhc17 as the top induced gene, but Zdhhc17 did not behave like a phenocopying neighbor. Instead, Zdhhc17 loss produced an opposite restricted signature, ranking as the 4th most anti-correlated perturbation among 1,982 perturbations when scored on the Irf2bpl top-200 genes. This pattern suggests Zdhhc17 is more consistent with a compensatory or counter-regulatory response to Irf2bpl perturbation than a simple mediator, although the lead Irf2bpl gene missed FDR significance and the anti-correlation used a nominally defined signature.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ahdc1 showed no robust perturbational neighbor in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: the strongest all-gene Pearson correlation was only with Camta1 (r=0.0956), one of the nearest positive signatures was the safe-target control Safe_target_23, and the weakest negatives, including Kmt2d, Crebbp, Nipbl, and Apc, were still near zero. Related chromatin or neurodevelopmental perturbations such as Arid2, Pura, Chd8, Auts2, and Kmt2b did not recapitulate the Ahdc1 signature. Apc showed only weak anticorrelation, with opposite movement of Spock3 and Rreb1 and canonical Wnt feedback genes activated by Apc, while Ahdc1 had Wls down without Axin2 or Nkd1 induction; this restricted, single-cell-class signature-neighbor analysis is an exploratory negative result rather than mechanistic epistasis.

Npy5r showed no robust convergence with the assayed NPY receptor paralogs: single Npy5r, Npy1r, and Npy2r perturbations were all transcriptionally silent at FDR<0.05, and the nominal Npy5r signature was not aligned with Npy1r or Npy2r across shared cell types, with near-zero Wilcoxon-score correlations. In 308 CB GABA cells, Npy5r had the strongest hypothesis-generating nominal signal, including Gnaz and Pde4a among top markers, yet Npy1r was only weakly anticorrelated there. Overall, NPY-family peptide GPCR signaling appears buffered in single-receptor perturbations, and any receptor-family effects likely depend on ligand, circuit, and combinatorial receptor context; ligand genes were not perturbed here.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Fgf1 showed no detectable response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut thalamic glutamatergic neurons, whereas the comparator Fgf13 was strongly depleted in the same cell class, indicating a divergent family-member response rather than interchangeable FGF/FGFR-pathway behavior. In this largest Fgf1-responsive class, clear signatures were seen for Map2k1, Braf, Pten, and Fgf13, but not Fgf1, consistent with Fgf13 acting within an intracellular FGF homologous factor or neuronal excitability module rather than as an extracellular FGFR ligand. This comparison is strongest for Fgf13 in this one cell class, and Fgf12 and Fgf14 were not mechanistically examined in depth.

cell_types: 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut
full_finding_text: Ephb1 in 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut hippocampal glutamatergic neurons showed a weak, nominal signature that aligned more with Tiam1 and Sos2 perturbation signatures than with Ephb2 or Ephb4. Across the top 300 absolute Ephb1-score genes, correlations were positive for Tiam1 and Sos2, while Ephb2 and Ephb4 were anticorrelated over the same restricted set. This pattern is consistent with an exploratory link to the Tiam1/Rac cytoskeletal branch of EphB signaling, but the CA3 contrasts for Ephb1, Tiam1, and Sos2 had no FDR-significant downstream genes, so the result is hypothesis-generating rather than definitive.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Nrp2 in 308 CB GABA showed an exploratory pattern within the semaphorin/neuropilin/plexin axon-guidance receptor network in which Plxnd1, and also Unc5c, appeared as anti-neighbors, while Nrp1 was only weakly positively aligned with Nrp2. The strongest related-target signal was therefore opposing rather than convergent, which is more consistent with local receptor rewiring or noise than a simple shared pathway output. This interpretation is cautious because Nrp2 itself had no FDR-significant genes in 308 CB GABA, and the anti-correlation comes from a signature-neighbor statistic rather than a measured biochemical interaction.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Hivep3 showed its largest whole-signature neighborhood in 308 CB GABA cells, where its signature weakly anticorrelated with Wdr26 and correlated with Ranbp2 rather than matching a thalamic R3hdm2 pathway neighbor. This cerebellar relationship was driven by a weak Hivep3 arm: Hivep3 had no FDR-significant genes in 308 CB GABA, with only nominal differential expression. As such, the Wdr26/Ranbp2 neighborhood should be viewed as exploratory and hypothesis-generating, based on a full-signature Pearson comparison in a single cell type.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Gnas showed no significant self-transcript depletion in these mouse-brain Perturb-seq screens, whereas the downstream cAMP/PKA node Prkaca was robustly depleted in 10 cell classes, including 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. This suggests the assay could register engagement within adenylate cyclase/cAMP/PKA signaling even though Gnas itself appeared silent, but the Prkaca effect was largely limited to its own transcript, with no significant non-Prkaca genes and no kinase-activity readout, indicating substantial transcriptional buffering.

cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut
full_finding_text: Atcay knockdown was associated with a weak, nominal increase in Acly mRNA in a single hypothalamic glutamatergic class, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut. This pattern is consistent with a tentative compensation hypothesis in the BNIP-H/Caytaxin ATP-citrate lyase cargo pathway, where ACL-pathway transcripts might rise when Caytaxin-mediated ACL transport is impaired. However, the Acly change was not FDR-significant, was confined to one Atcay-engaged cell class, and should be treated only as an exploratory biomarker-level observation for follow-up.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Clcn3 showed a weak, restricted transcriptional signature centered in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, but the related endosomal CLC paralogs Clcn4 and Clcn5 did not phenocopy it. In this cell type, Clcn4 was more strongly self-knocked down than Clcn3 yet was anticorrelated with the weak Clcn3 top-gene signature, and Clcn5 was also not close to the Clcn3 pattern. The divergence was also seen across 052 Pvalb Gaba and 155 MB Glut within the ClC-3/ClC-4 endosomal exchanger module, although this comparison is exploratory because the Clcn3 program itself was weak and not FDR-robust.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Jakmip1 perturbation did not produce a Gabbr1- or Gabbr2-like transcriptional state across 052 Pvalb Gaba, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 308 CB GABA. Although Gabbr1 and Gabbr2 perturbations were detectably engaged in the same differential-expression table, their transcriptomic Wilcoxon score-vector correlations with Jakmip1 were near zero in matched cell types; in 308 CB GABA, the largest cross-perturbation correlations were still small (|r|<=0.230) and even opposite in sign for Gabbr1 versus Gabbr2. This suggests the shared GABA-B receptor microtubule/kinesin transport biology may be post-transcriptional or compartment-specific rather than captured as shared mRNA changes.

Bbx did not phenocopy the HMG-box subfamily comparator Cic in matched mouse brain cell types. Across the same 22 Bbx cell types, Cic produced 612 FDR-significant rows across six groups, whereas Bbx produced none, and Bbx–Cic score correlations stayed near zero. This divergence was evident even in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, where Bbx showed only a nominal Prrg3 decrease, and in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, the highest-count Bbx stratum, where Cic was highly active but Bbx remained non-significant. The contrast reflects downstream signature strength rather than direct biochemical interchangeability, and Cic target engagement is also imperfect at the transcript row.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Coa8 showed no robust convergence or opposition with other perturbations: across five Coa8-enriched cell contexts, full-signature searches found no reproducible neighbor or opposite signature, and the strongest nonself correlations were only about 0.06–0.12. This held in 155 MB Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 191 MB P MY GABA, despite comparisons to Cox7b, Ndufs4, Pgrmc1, Snap25, Mapk8ip1, and Rack1. Because the Coa8 signature was weak and only five contexts were searched, assignment to an in-dataset module or suppressor signature remains unsupported.
