cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Gpr161 perturbation showed no detected Hedgehog derepression across all assayed adult brain cell types, including multiple cortical and hippocampal glutamatergic classes, GABAergic populations such as Pvalb and Sst, hypothalamic, midbrain, pineal, and cerebellar GABA cells. Canonical output genes Gli1, Ptch1, Ptch2, Hhip, as well as Gli2, Gli3, and Foxa2, were not induced, and Gpr161 did not co-cluster with Smo, Ptch1/2, Gli1/2/3, Ift88, Adcy3, Adcy5, or Cdon perturbations. This negative call is transcriptomic and occurred with weak Gpr161 mRNA engagement, so it does not assess acute ciliary cAMP or GLI2/GLI3 post-translational processing.

Acvr1 knockdown was largely uncoupled from canonical BMP-SMAD/ID transcriptional output: across 22 contrasts, Id1, Id2, Id3, Id4, Msx1, and Msx2 were not nominally changed, and Smad7 showed only a single nominal, FDR-negative shift in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons. This pattern suggests the nominal Acvr1 signatures are not simply basal BMP-SMAD1/5/8 signaling running in reverse. A caveat is that some BMP targets were lowly detected in neurons, and Smad6 was measured in only two Acvr1 contrasts.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Pdha1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a transcriptomically target-only pattern, with almost no downstream differential expression, whereas the pathway-neighbor perturbation Mdh1 in the same cell type produced a broad response with 29 FDR-significant genes, 28 of them non-target. This contrast suggests the muted Pdha1 signal is not simply a limit of the 151-cell background or sample size, and that nearby central-carbon perturbations can be much more transcriptionally penetrant. However, Mdh1 is not a PDH subunit, and the responsive genes cannot be assumed to be direct metabolic sensors.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Zbtb11 perturbation in mouse brain neurons produced a convergent, mostly down-regulated program rather than a single target transcript, centered on mitochondrial and nucleolar/RNA-processing genes with a recurring endomembrane/glycan arm. Across 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and smaller 145 MH-LH TH Glut and 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut classes, recurrent decreases included Ndufc2, Ndufaf1, Gtpbp3, Acsf3, Rbm28, Taf1b, Stx16, Pigq, and Man2c1; Mtg1, Dhx16, and only in 191 MB P MY GABA, Ppargc1a, were selectively increased. These Golgi, GPI-anchor, and glycan genes are co-responses, and direct Zbtb11 promoter binding was not shown in the assayed neurons.

Gnptab showed no resolved transcriptional program in this dataset: across all 22 Gnptab-scored cell groups, no group had on-target Gnptab or downstream genes passing FDR < 0.05, and score-vector correlations with Gnptg were nearly zero, with similarly weak correlations to Atp6v0c, Ctsb, and Gaa. A whole-library scan also found no strong positive or negative signature neighbor, with the largest absolute correlation only 0.145. Thus, despite GNPTAB/GNPTG pathway membership, the measured Gnptab signature should not be interpreted as an M6P-tagging or lysosomal-trafficking module, and the weak, null-dominated correlations do not support antagonism or pathway rewiring.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Ap3b1 did not define a trustworthy convergent transcriptomic module in 308 CB GABA or across related comparisons. Signatures from selected AP-3/BLOC-1 and lysosome-neighbor perturbations, including Ap3b2, Dtnbp1, Lyst, Vps35, and Vps41, showed near-zero mean correlations with Ap3b1 across shared cell types, and even the strongest unrestricted same-cell-type neighbor was weak, with Ranbp2 reaching only |r|=0.212 in 308 CB GABA. This should be treated mainly as a guardrail against over-interpreting top neighbors, because the Ap3b1 signature itself was weak and some disease-adjacent perturbations lacked corrected transcriptomic responses in this screen.

Eng perturbation did not produce a canonical BMP9/10-ENG-ALK1-SMAD or vascular-neighbor transcriptional response in the assayed mouse brain neuronal classes: Acvrl1, Notch1, Id1, Id3, Kdr, and Tek remained at FDR=1.0, and genome-wide testing showed no conventionally significant downstream signal. This contrasts with literature placing endoglin upstream of ALK1-SMAD signaling, but the apparent uncoupling is tempered by weak target engagement, as Eng itself never showed negative on-target enrichment or FDR-supported knockdown, and the assessment relied on DE rows rather than protein phosphorylation or ligand-stimulated SMAD assays.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Vps37a in the two main mushroom body cell classes, 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, showed a restricted same-direction signature whose nearest perturbation neighbors on Vps37a-responsive genes were Psmb4, Psmc5, Pomp, Psmc1, Snf8, Atp6v1a, and Vps53/Vps54/Rab7, rather than Chmp4b or Becn1. This pattern suggests alignment with degradative proteostasis and endolysosomal trafficking stress more than a generic autophagy or ESCRT-III transcriptional state, although the analysis was exploratory, post hoc, and limited to Vps37a FDR genes, so generic stress enrichment remains a caveat.

Hcn2 knockdown did not produce compensatory RNA induction of its closest HCN-channel paralogs or the TRIP8b/Pex5l auxiliary module: Hcn1, Hcn3, Hcn4, and Pex5l showed no adjusted transcriptional response, and after excluding the assayed target transcript there were no adjusted differentially expressed genes across all 22 cell classes. Given the HCN-channel assembly and TRIP8b/Pex5l regulation context, these data argue against a simple transcriptional replacement loop, while still leaving open post-transcriptional adaptation such as channel relocalization, altered gating, TRIP8b isoform shifts, or protein-level compensation.

cell_types: 022 L5 ET CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Pax7 showed a nonconvergent response relative to other assayed PAX-family perturbations in 022 L5 ET CTX Glut: its only corrected hit was Ruvbl1 up-regulation, and the restricted L5 ET signature involving Ruvbl1, Wnk2, Ahcyl1, Itfg1, Ncan, and Fth1 was not reproduced by Pax1, Pax2, Pax3, Pax4, Pax5, Pax6, or Pax8. In this atlas, those other PAX perturbations had no multiple-testing-corrected responses, and the nearest PAX-family comparison was an anti-correlation for Pax8 rather than convergence with Pax3. This comparison is exploratory because it used only the top and bottom 25 Pax7 scores in one cell type, and safe-target controls among top neighbors suggest sampling noise.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Mef2a in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut class showed weak positive whole-transcriptome convergence with Mef2c, Celf2, and Cic, and the Celf2 and Cic guide signatures shared repression of Gpr4, Ogt, and Prkcg with the Mef2a signature. This suggests a local MEF2 paralog transcription-factor module in thalamus that is broader than the canonical HDAC/MAPK neighbor list, although the effect was exploratory because all-gene correlations were small and the Cic guide did not show FDR-level depletion of Cic mRNA itself.

Npsr1 perturbation was essentially uncorrelated with perturbations of canonical proximal G-protein and cAMP signaling components, including Gnas, Gnal, Gnao1, Adcy1, Adcy3, Adcy5, Plcb1, Prkaca, Creb1, and Crebbp, with near-zero within-cell-type transcriptomic correlations overall. In this dataset, Npsr1 signatures were also nearly orthogonal to related neuropeptide receptor perturbations, so the expected NPSR1 Gαq/Gαs calcium-cAMP-ERK pathway was not recovered as a transcriptional module. A key caveat is that these comparisons use steady-state transcriptomic score vectors, whereas prior literature measured acute ligand-driven second-messenger responses.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Slc7a6os perturbation produced a mixed RNA polymerase II/RNA-processing response rather than a uniform loss of Pol-II transcripts: Polr2a was up-regulated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, and 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, Son increased in the stronger glutamatergic signatures, and Srrm2 and Pnisr were reduced in the same neighborhood, with Snrnp200 and Dhx37 also recurring. The dominant response was in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, while 007 showed only Polr2a, so Polr2a appears recurrent but not sufficient alone. This state is inferred from mRNA, as Pol-II import and SLC7A6OS protein were not measured.

Dap3 showed a buffered mitochondrial perturbation pattern in which target mRNA was reduced but downstream transcriptional effects were sparse, particularly in 052 Pvalb Gaba, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, and 155 MB Glut. Available mitochondrial translation or RNA-handling comparators including Fars2, Gfm2, Lars2, Lrpprc, Pnpt1, and Rars2 likewise produced no robust differential-expression signatures, while strong respiratory-chain knockdowns of Ndufa13 and Ndufb7 were also largely target-only. Because no Mrps/Mrpl structural subunits were present as direct comparators, the sparse Dap3 signature should not be overread as uniquely DAP3-specific.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Chrnb2 knockdown did not produce FDR-supported compensatory induction of alternative nicotinic receptor subunit mRNAs in the engaged classes 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA. In these settings, Chrna2, Chrna3, Chrna4, Chrna5, Chrna6, Chrna7, and Chrnb3 remained non-significant after Chrnb2 depletion, arguing against a simple transcriptional compensation program within beta2-containing nicotinic acetylcholine receptor signaling, although mRNA measurements may miss changes in receptor assembly, trafficking, or stoichiometry.

Tcf20 did not show a Rai1-like or broader neurodevelopmental-regulator transcriptional signature. Across 21 shared cell types, Tcf20 and Rai1 full-score vectors were essentially uncorrelated, and Tcf20 also lacked strong full-transcriptome correlation with Tcf4, Chd8, Setd5, Mecp2, Med13l, Tbr1, Foxg1, Kat6a, Ep300, Med12, and Htt. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, Tcf20 was nonconvergent with active comparators in a neurodevelopmental transcription-regulator response. This interpretation is limited because the Tcf20 perturbation produced a weak signature, so near-zero correlations could reflect perturbation failure rather than true biological separation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut
full_finding_text: Las1l was not Kmt2a-like across matched cell types, despite LAS1L being annotated in some MLL1/5FMC-associated assemblies. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, and 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut, Kmt2a perturbation showed FDR-significant transcriptional remodeling, including a strong 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut signature, whereas Las1l was largely null and same-cell Las1l-Kmt2a correlations were near zero. An isolated nominal Rnf150/Golgb1-positive tail in 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut did not support a validated Las1l biomarker call. This divergence refines rather than contradicts the MLL1/5FMC annotation, since KMT2A is a broad chromatin regulator rather than a direct LAS1L-NOL9 catalytic partner.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Vps54 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed its closest same-cell perturbation similarity to Atp6v0c, with additional modest positive convergence to trafficking/endolysosomal genes including Pitpna, Caml, Grin1, Cltc, Atp2a2, Rab7, and Gbf1. The Vps54 and Atp6v0c signatures agreed in direction for 30 of 31 Vps54 FDR genes, linking the response to an endolysosomal proton-pump and trafficking axis rather than a generic transcriptional artifact. However, the convergence was partial only, with a top correlation of r=0.361, weak measured Vps54 mRNA depletion, and a much larger direct-transcript and DE effect for Atp6v0c.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Ppargc1b perturbation showed a recurrent but mostly nominal downregulation of mitochondrial/TCA and OXPHOS genes across several neuronal cell types, most clearly in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, with 155 MB Glut providing the only FDR-significant response. Repeated decreases involved Idh3b, Uqcrc1, Dlst, Atp5b, Atp5j, Slc25a3, and Ndufa10, consistent with a small negative module affecting oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial ATP synthesis, and TCA enzymes. In 155 MB Glut, Atp5b was down and related PGC-1 paralog or PPAR receptor perturbations did not reproduce this signature. Because most effects were nominal p<0.05, this should be treated as a module-level hypothesis rather than a list of individually validated DE genes.

Cspp1 perturbation did not produce a coherent transcriptional response in this mouse brain dataset: canonical Hedgehog genes including Gli1, Gli2, Gli3, Ptch1, Ptch2, Smo, Shh, Ihh, Dhh, and Hhip were not detectably changed, and CSPP1-linked ciliary transcripts such as Arl13b, Adcy3, Cep104, Cep290, Rpgrip1l, Armc9, Togaram1, and Ccdc66 were likewise uncoupled. Nominal centrosome-related shifts in Pcm1, Cep57, Ttll4, Cep63, and Tubg1 were scattered across cell types and did not survive multiple testing, with the caveat that structural, developmental, Hedgehog-stimulated, or weak Cspp1-dependent effects may not be captured by unstimulated brain-cell mRNA readouts.

Nr1h4 perturbation did not engage the canonical FXR bile-acid transcriptional program in this assay. Across tested cell types, no gene-level response passed FDR correction, and canonical FXR or related cholesterol genes including Nr0b2, Fabp6, Slc51b, Slc51a, Abcb11, Cyp7a1, Abca1, and Cyp46a1 were not detectably changed. Because many hepatointestinal FXR targets are sparse in brain and the experiment reflects basal mouse brain loss perturbation, this result supports pathway inactivity in this context rather than failure of an otherwise active neuronal FXR circuit.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Abcc9 could not be directly compared with its canonical KATP partners because Kcnj8, Kcnj11, and Abcc8 were not perturbed, and among available neuronal ion-channel perturbations such as Kcnh5, Cacna1g, Kcnb1, Kcnb2, Scn2a, and Kcna2, transcriptomic score-vector correlations to Abcc9 were mostly near zero. The main exception was a weak, cell-type-restricted neighborhood in 308 CB GABA; in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, the largest absolute correlation to another perturbation and the largest ion-channel-family correlation were still small. These results therefore leave known ATP-sensitive potassium channel biology only indirectly addressed and are limited to RNA-based signatures rather than channel activity.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Stxbp1 perturbation produced its broadest downstream response in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut neurons, where 66 non-target genes changed with a predominantly synaptic/glutamatergic downregulation pattern, including Nrxn2, Itpka, Slc30a3, Grin2b, Gria3, Homer1, and Cplx1, alongside a smaller upregulated Nrsn1/Pcsk1n/Scg2/Chgb counter-module. This cell-type-selective signature aligns with SNARE-associated neurotransmitter-release pathway membership, but partner genes were not uniformly coupled, and the counter-module remains hypothesis-generating because RNA changes alone do not establish altered vesicle release.

Coa8 perturbation did not produce a coordinated Complex IV mRNA phenotype: across assayed cell types, including 155 MB Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, no Cox-family or mitochondrial mt-Co transcript such as Cox19, Cox7b, Cox5a, Cox16, mt-Co2, or mt-Co1 reached FDR significance, and targeted checks found only uncorrected signals. This clean negative result is notable because COA8 is a COX assembly factor, suggesting the single-cell mRNA readout here is uncoupled from protein assembly, abundance, or enzymatic activity phenotypes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA
full_finding_text: Thap1 showed its most reproducible downstream program as a recurrent, noncanonical Prepl/Cuedc2/Fam117a module: Prepl and Cuedc2 decreased while Fam117a increased across midbrain and pontine/medullary neurons, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA. The signal was strongest in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, significant as a compact triad in midbrain glutamatergic neurons, but only partial in 052 Pvalb Gaba and weakly recurrent in 054 CNU-MGE GABA. This module is based on differential expression rather than rescue or binding data, and Fam117a and Cuedc2 were only nominal in some class-specific extensions.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Ep300 did not phenocopy its KAT3 paralog Crebbp in this dataset. In the shared thalamic glutamatergic cell type 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Crebbp produced a corrected response with 8 FDR-significant genes, including Stxbp2, whereas Ep300 produced none. Across the eight cell types where both were assayed, their whole-transcriptome signatures were nearly uncorrelated, with Pearson correlations from -0.016 to 0.090. This contrast argues against treating p300/CBP as interchangeable here, although measured depletion of both target transcripts was weak.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kmt5b perturbation showed its clearest response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, the only class with FDR-significant differential expression, where postsynaptic genes were mostly upregulated and translation factors were mixed. The signal included Ache, Syngap1, Grik1, near-threshold Nlgn2, Sptbn1, Rab3a, and Rab3gap2, with Eif4e and Eif4g3 positive but Eif2a negative. STRING analysis of a nominal p<0.001 gene set recovered postsynapse and translation-initiation terms, although only four postsynaptic genes were FDR-significant or borderline, and there was no measurable Kmt5b mRNA depletion.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Cyld showed transcriptional signatures that were essentially orthogonal to Sqstm1, Tbk1, Tnfrsf1a, and Mtor in the two best-engaged cell types, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut. In these acute neuronal perturbation data, Cyld had no strong positive or negative genome-wide signature neighbor, with all same-cell correlations remaining below |Pearson r| 0.073, despite weak nominal autophagy or ubiquitin-related hints and, in 155 MB Glut, a nominal candidate module without adjusted-significant genes. These correlations are transcriptomic and limited to overlapping same-cell perturbations; Optn and SPATA2/LUBAC components were not targeted.

Rlim showed no strong transcriptional coupling to its screened canonical neighborhood in the assayed brain populations: its perturbation signature only weakly correlated with Ube2e2, Lhx3, Lhx4, Isl1, Lmx1a, and Lmx1b, and these related perturbations did not produce FDR-significant matched responses. Thus, the RNA screen does not support Rlim as phenocopying or strongly opposing these nearby ubiquitin/LIM-homeodomain module components. This is a negative pathway-level result limited to genes present in the screen, and it reflects expression-signature correlations rather than protein-substrate assays.

cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Tgfbr1 perturbation did not detectably engage the canonical TGF-beta/SMAD transcriptional program across many glutamatergic and GABAergic neuronal cell types. Smad2, Smad3, Smad4, Smad7, Serpine1, Id1/2/3, Junb, Ski, Skil, and Tgfbr2 showed no FDR-supported changes, and the strongest nominal effects did not form a recurrent same-direction module. This mostly negative result may reflect absent Tgfbr1 knockdown, and the transcriptional readout cannot directly assess phospho-SMAD activity. Even in Pvalb Gaba and L5 ET CTX Glut, the best nominal genes remained non-significant and lacked a canonical TGF-beta signature.

Cog4 perturbation did not transcriptionally engage the measured COG/Golgi trafficking module: Golgi neighbors Cog5, Stx16, Stx5a, Vps53, and Vps54 were only nominal at best and none was FDR significant. This leaves Cog4 largely uncoupled from the assayed COG/Golgi vesicle tethering, Golgi glycosylation, and Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport/SNARE-pairing signatures, despite its pathway placement. The result is therefore a pathway-level negative in this dataset, with the caveat that only mRNA abundance was measured, not Golgi morphology, trafficking flux, or glycan structure.

Krit1 perturbation in the neuronal panel did not engage the canonical CCM complex/MEKK3-KLF2-KLF4 transcriptional program: across 21 Krit1-tested neuronal classes, Klf2, Klf4, and Map3k3 were measured but showed no coherent induction, with all reported comparisons at FDR=1.0. This keeps the mouse neuronal signatures mechanistically separate from the canonical endothelial CCM lesion pathway, although interpretation is limited because the upstream Krit1 perturbation was weak and the assay was performed in neurons rather than endothelial cells.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Grin1 in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cell type showed restricted-signature neighbors that were largely non-NMDAR perturbations: positive similarity with Vps54, Atp6v0c, Scn1b, Snap25, and Dlgap4, and opposing signatures with Wdfy3, Gabrb2, and Gsk3b. Notably, the nearest signatures were not other NMDA receptor subunits such as Grin2a or Grin2b, suggesting the downstream Grin1 state may reflect a broader cellular response that converges with non-receptor perturbations. These relationships are exploratory because genome-wide Pearson correlations were modest, and some neighbors, especially Vps54, lacked a strong self-transcript row.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Lrp6 showed a selective thalamic response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: unlike Lrp5 and the assayed surface receptors Fzd2, Fzd3, Fzd4, Fzd6, Fzd9, Kremen1, and Lgr4, it produced the only FDR-resolved signature and repressed the Wnt feedback marker Axin2, with a direction that weakly matched Ctnnb1 loss and opposed Apc. Even though some comparator perturbations had more assigned cells than Lrp6, they did not phenocopy it; however, because most comparators lacked target-transcript validation, the result is compatible with receptor redundancy or ineffective perturbation rather than strict noninvolvement.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kdm4c showed a near-null transcriptional response in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut class: despite the largest Kdm4c perturbation-cell count and a borderline reduction of the target transcript, there were no FDR-significant downstream hits. In the same cell type, the comparator lysine demethylase Kdm5c produced 18 FDR-significant genes, including Ptgds and Capn3, indicating that the lack of Kdm4c hits is target-specific rather than a general failure to detect chromatin-enzyme perturbations. Because Kdm4c and Kdm5c act on different lysine substrates and used different guides, this contrast is an assay comparison, not a mechanistic epistasis test.

Isl1 showed no transcriptomic convergence with Lhx3 or related developmental transcription-factor perturbations, with weak score-vector correlations across Lhx3, Lhx4, Lmx1a, Lmx1b, Mnx1, Phox2a, Phox2b, Pou4f3, Nkx6-2, Atoh1, Neurog3, and Tlx3. This does not support a shared adult-brain signature for the Isl1-Lhx3 developmental transcriptional complex, and similarly does not support Isl1-Lhx8 circuitry, although Lhx8 was only measured as a transcript and not as a perturbation comparator. Interpretation is limited because the Isl1 signature itself was weak.

Cspg4 was uncoupled from an expected NG2 growth-factor and adhesion neighborhood across all assayed neuronal classes: Cspg4 perturbation produced no transcriptome-wide FDR-significant differentially expressed genes, and related perturbations were likewise sparse, with Sox10, Pdgfrb, and Itga4 showing no FDR-significant rows and Fgfr1, Fgfr2, and Mapk1 each yielding only a single significant row in the panel. In 155 MB Glut cells, 209 Cspg4-perturbed cells still showed no Cspg4 response, and isolated Fgfr1 or Mapk1 hits did not form a shared Cspg4-like module. This supports a neuron-specific absence of a coordinated PDGF/FGF/integrin state, with the caveat that Pdgfra, Fgf2, Olig1, and Olig2 were not assayed and sparse Fgfr/Mapk hits are not equivalent to a CSPG4 pathway response.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba
full_finding_text: Phf12 perturbation repeatedly induced a compact Ptcd3/Chpf2/Atp6v0b/Stx16/Sf3b2/Stk16 module across responsive neuronal classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 217 P MY Pineal Glut, and 052 Pvalb Gaba. In the strongest thalamic response, up-regulated genes were enriched for an RNA splicing/ribonucleoprotein program including Sfswap and Snrnp70, while smaller GABAergic subcortical classes showed weaker but similar induction. These recurrent genes largely encode general RNA-processing or organellar proteins, so the data do not establish them as direct PHF12 targets.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Mdh1 perturbation produced its only broad FDR-significant downstream module in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells, where an excitatory-synapse transcript subset was downregulated: Nrxn1, Cadm3, Lrrtm1, and Grin2b all decreased, and this same four-gene set mapped to the excitatory synapse compartment. This links MDH1 loss to a neuronal connectivity/readout module rather than only a generic mitochondrial transcriptome, but the signal rests on four significant genes and reflects a transcript-level synaptic signature rather than a measured synapse phenotype.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Rb1cc1 showed positive signature convergence with Tsc1 and Tsc2 specifically in 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA, where the much larger Tsc perturbation signatures selectively overlapped the restricted Rb1cc1 program. In these same midbrain classes, Rb1cc1 was associated with ER and neuronal membrane transcript changes, including genes such as Sec31a, Pomp, Gbf1, Caml, Wac, and Adam10. The correlation was based on the top 200 Rb1cc1-ranked genes, so the stronger Tsc signatures and several exploratory neighbors, including Rhobtb2 and Ghsr, should be interpreted cautiously.

Myod1 targeting in brain cells did not detectably engage the canonical skeletal-muscle differentiation program: core myogenic regulators and terminal markers, including Myog, Myf5, Myf6, Acta1, Des, and Ckm, remained nonsignificant relative to non-targeting cells. This pattern suggests CRISPR loss of a largely silent Myod1 locus in neuronal nuclei rather than a test of MYOD sufficiency to impose muscle fate, and it should be interpreted separately from forced-MYOD gain-of-function studies in fibroblasts and other permissive lineages.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Arid1b showed a weak, self-limited convergence with canonical BAF/SWI-SNF member loss in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells. In this cell type, Smarcb1, Smarcc2, and Arid1a were among the closest positive transcriptomic neighbors of Arid1b, and cBAF-associated response genes such as Ptpn3 and Reep2 shifted in the same down-regulatory direction only nominally after Arid1b perturbation. The correlations were small, Ptpn3 and Reep2 did not pass FDR for Arid1b, and this BAF-neighbor convergence was not a global feature across all strongly engaged Arid1b cell classes.

Gcgr showed only weak perturbation signatures, and these did not resemble a canonical G protein–adenylyl cyclase transcriptional program: its profiles were essentially uncorrelated with Gnas, Adcy1, Adcy3, Adcy5, or indirect GPCR/cAMP neighbors such as Pth1r, Mc3r, and Mc4r, and genome-wide analysis did not reveal any strong positive or negative transcriptomic neighbor. Across the broad unstimulated mouse brain cell classes assayed, the nominal tail did not form a recurrent same-direction module. This null-like interpretation is limited because available comparisons were indirect neighbors, without direct Gcg, Glp1r, Glp2r, Gipr, Sctr, or Vipr perturbations.

Prop1 did not converge with the pituitary transcription-factor comparators Hesx1, Pou1f1, Lhx3, Lhx4, and Tbx19 in the assayed mouse brain classes: all perturbations showed weak profiles, with no FDR-significant rows, and Prop1-comparator whole-transcriptome Wilcoxon-score correlations remained weak, reaching at most |r| = 0.110. Thus, the pituitary transcription-factor differentiation network was not reconstituted in these brain classes, which refines rather than contradicts their known relationship in pituitary development, especially since the comparison was performed in brain classes rather than embryonic Rathke’s pouch or pituitary endocrine cells.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Xpo1 targeting in neurons repeatedly produced a stereotyped bidirectional transcript response across 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA cells: Arrdc3, Slc16a6, Vamp2, and Sun2 tended to increase, while an RNA-processing module centered on Snrnp70, Pabpn1, Arglu1, Srsf-family genes, and Zcchc7 decreased. The strongest signatures were in thalamic and midbrain glutamatergic classes, with smaller but coherent responses in hypothalamic GABA and low-count hypothalamic/thalamic glutamatergic cells. Tpr showed convergent restricted-signature similarity, but the assay captures steady-state mRNAs rather than XPO1 protein, cargo localization, or direct export.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Tmem163 depletion in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut did not phenocopy stronger endolysosomal or vesicle-acidification perturbations. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Atp6v0c and Rab7 produced hundreds of FDR genes, whereas Tmem163 showed only its own knockdown; in 155 MB Glut, Atp6v0c, Rab7, Cltc, and Atp6v1a also produced broader signatures that were weakly to negatively correlated with Tmem163. These RNA-based comparisons, using pathway neighbors rather than TMEM163 complex members, argue against a simple generic lysosome-stress program after Tmem163 loss.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Gtf2i showed a cell-type-specific response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut that was not phenocopied by other tested Williams-Beuren 7q11.23 genes. In this thalamic class, Baz1b knockdown was on-target yet produced no non-target FDR hits and had almost zero all-gene score correlation with Gtf2i, while Gtf2ird1, Fzd9, Limk1, and Eif4h were also not close transcriptomic neighbors. This supports a Gtf2i-specific TFII-I-associated RNA polymerase II transcriptional module rather than a generic co-deleted locus effect, although several comparators lacked clear self-transcript knockdown, limiting mechanistic conclusions.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Vps13c showed a weak, target-specific transcriptomic response in 155 MB Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells: despite FDR-significant Vps13c depletion in MB Glut, there were no non-target FDR hits, and in TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut only weak nominal reduction was seen. In the same cell types, pathway neighbors Dnm1l and Vps35 produced multi-gene FDR programs at equal or lower cell counts, including stress-response genes such as Asns, Ddit3, and Chac1, indicating assay competence. This contrast suggests Vps13c was weaker than nearby Parkinson disease organelle-quality-control perturbations, while not implying the expected direction of VPS13C loss because Dnm1l and Vps35 are neighbors rather than VPS13C complex members.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Xpo1 showed a recurrent transcriptomic neighbor in Tpr across five responsive cell classes—066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—whereas Xpo7, Ranbp2, Nup93, and Kpna3 were not broadly interchangeable with the Xpo1 signature. This pattern was seen in restricted top-250-gene similarity analyses within the Ran-dependent CRM1/XPO1 nuclear export and nuclear-pore coupling pathway, and should be interpreted as transcriptomic convergence rather than proof of molecular interaction in these cells.

Slc6a17 perturbation produced transcriptomic effects that were orthogonal to the SLC6-family comparators Slc6a1 and Slc6a5, indicating these transporters were not interchangeable in the assayed neuronal classes. Slc6a17 signatures were essentially uncorrelated with Slc6a1 or Slc6a5 and, unlike those paralogs, were associated with the Jun/Stmn4/Kctd16 module. Slc6a1 knockdown was confined to a few GABAergic classes, while Slc6a5 showed no detectable on-target depletion in the same Slc6a17-tested classes, making Slc6a5 a technical negative comparator rather than a successful glycine-transporter perturbation.

Kcnc3 knockdown did not detectably alter mRNA abundance in the literature-nominated KCNC3-HAX1-Arp2/3-TBK1 module: Hax1, Tbk1, and the assayed Arp2/3 subunits Actr3, Arpc1a, Arpc1b, Arpc2, Arpc3, Arpc4, Arpc5, and Arpc5l were not FDR-regulated. This suggests that reported Kv3.3 links to cortical actin, HAX1 trafficking, and TBK1 may be mediated mainly through channel-protein assembly, localization, and phosphorylation rather than acute transcriptional control, although only selected transcripts were tested and protein localization, actin polymerization, and TBK1 activity were not measured.

Tbx5 perturbation showed no detected regulation of canonical TBX5 effector programs in the assayed brain classes: Nppa, Gja5, Scn5a, Fgf10, Wnt2, and Sfrp1 were measured across all 21 Tbx5 signatures yet remained unchanged, with minimum FDR values of 1.000. This included 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut, where Cbl was the strongest Tbx5-associated hit but canonical effectors were still silent. Thus, the brain null result appears to refine rather than contradict known TBX5 programs from heart, lung, and retina, which arise in different tissues and developmental stages.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Zmynd8 perturbation in the dominant 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut population produced a mixed synaptic and neuronal-projection RNA signature rather than clear induction or repression of core NuRD subunit transcripts. In this cell type, Gabbr2, Nrxn1, Grm1, Trim9, and Lrrc7 were decreased, while P2rx7, Scn1b, Cck, and Src were increased, indicating a receptor/adhesion/calcium-related output. This synaptic pathway label comes from enrichment of a 74-gene list, and the experiment measures RNA rather than chromatin binding or synaptic physiology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Fzd4 was essentially silent in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, where a contrasting downstream perturbation of Ctnnb1 produced a strong beta-catenin–responsive transcriptomic signature. In this same cell type, Ctnnb1 had 383 FDR-significant genes, whereas Fzd4 had none; its Norrin-receptor neighbors Lrp6 and Tspan12 were also weak, with 4 and 1 significant hits, respectively. This suggests that in this neuronal class, the FZD4/Norrin/Wnt-beta-catenin pathway is uncoupled at the receptor level even though downstream beta-catenin can strongly affect the transcriptome, with the caveat that the comparison is transcriptomic and the canonical Norrin/FZD4/TSPAN12 literature is mainly vascular.

Arnt loss did not phenocopy the measured bHLH-PAS partners or its paralog Arnt2: across shared cell classes, Arnt score-vector correlations with Ahr, Ahrr, Arnt2, Hif1a, Sim1, and Npas3 were near zero. In this baseline dataset there was also no robust FDR-level Arnt output in aryl hydrocarbon/xenobiotic signaling or hypoxia-inducible-factor transcriptional response, including weak correspondence to Ahr/Ahrr and no robust basal HIF1A-like program. This argues against an obvious linear ARNT-family module here, although most comparator perturbations were themselves weak, so lack of convergence may reflect limited target engagement or inactive stimuli as well as biology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Serpine2 knockdown produced a narrow transcriptional phenotype rather than broad extracellular serpin pathway rewiring. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, Serpine2 and Clip2 were the only FDR-significant transcripts, while canonical SERPINE2-axis mRNAs including Plau, Plat, Plaur, Lrp1, Serpini1, and F2r were not detectably changed; 022 L5 ET CTX Glut showed only nominal Serpine2 and Prnp co-decrease without FDR-significant response, and 155 MB Glut showed nominal target depletion only. These data suggest transcriptional uncoupling of the thrombin-plasminogen/LRP neighborhood, with the caveat that extracellular protein activity could still change without mRNA shifts.

cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Sncb knockdown produced a largely self-only transcriptomic response across engaged classes including 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA. Despite strong target depletion in some of these cell types, presynaptic and synuclein-family neighbors such as Snca, Sncg, Vamp2, Snap25, Cplx1, Nrsn1, and Nrsn2 remained unchanged at FDR, indicating that the known presynaptic vesicle/SNARE module was uncoupled at the mRNA level. This caveat is important because the reported biology for beta-synuclein mainly concerns protein localization, vesicle cycling, dopamine uptake, or aging rather than acute transcript abundance.

Pld3 showed no meaningful convergence with APP/endosomal-sorting and Alzheimer disease gene perturbations in this assay: across doubly engaged comparisons with App, Cst3, Sorl1, Grn, and Tmem106b, the maximum absolute Pearson correlation was only 0.0699, and in the strongest Pld3 cell type, 155 MB Glut, the top positive and negative genome-wide signature neighbors were just r=0.0458 and r=-0.0351. This signature-based result suggests acute Pld3 mRNA loss was largely orthogonal to these measured disease-gene programs here, although direct contrasts with PLD-family paralogs were not possible because Pld1, Pld2, and Pld4 were not perturbed.

Pacs1 perturbation did not produce a shared trafficking mRNA signature with Pacs2 or with assayed AP-1, clathrin, sortilin-family, or retromer genes, including Ap1b1, Ap1s2, Sort1, Sorl1, Vps35, and Cltc. Across 21 matched cell types, Pacs1–Pacs2 full-score correlations were near zero, and correlations to these pathway neighbors were similarly weak. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, Pacs1 depletion was only nominal, with no FDR-significant response and no convergence with Ap1b1. These comparisons relied on weak Pacs1 contrasts and only the pathway-neighbor genes present in the perturbation library.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Nrf1 perturbation in mouse brain cells produced a partial, divergent mitochondrial response rather than a wholesale NRF1/PGC-1 mitochondrial-biogenesis program. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA cells, respiratory-chain genes were affected, with Sdha reduced in all three major responsive classes and Uqcrc1 reduced in 191 MB P MY GABA, while Ndufs8 was nominally up. By contrast, canonical mitochondrial-transcription factors Tfam, Tfb1m, Tfb2m, and Polrmt were not FDR-significant, though these targets may be insensitive at the sampled time point or protein level, and target mRNA reduction was not directly measured.

cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut
full_finding_text: Yme1l1 showed near-zero transcriptome-wide similarity to mitochondrial protease neighbors and the Opa1 axis in its best-engaged cell type, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut. In this cell class, Afg3l2, Lonp1, Clpp, and Opa1 all had full-score correlations with Yme1l1 close to zero, despite their functional proximity in mitochondrial inner-membrane protein degradation and OPA1 processing. This comparison is limited to one cell type and RNA signatures, and Yme1l1 itself had a weak downstream signature, so the null similarities are conservative but somewhat noisy.

Srsf1 depletion did not trigger a simple compensatory rise in related SR-factor regulators; instead, transcripts for Srsf2 and Hnrnpdl were recurrently reduced across 17 cell types, with Clk4 decreased in 12 and Clk1 in 5. In mRNA splicing and processing, Srsf1 loss showed mixed effects overall but converged with Tnpo3 perturbation in several cell types, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, where Clk transcripts were reduced. These data show co-regulation after Srsf1 perturbation, but do not establish whether the decreases are direct SRSF1 targets or secondary effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Mecp2 loss produced a small neuronal ion-channel/membrane signature in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with mixed directions across genes such as Ache, Fxyd7, L1cam, Itpr1, Kcnh5, Mast1, and Mgat5, while Cacna1g was downregulated there and also in 155 MB Glut. Notably, Cacna1g was the only FDR-significant Mecp2-downregulated gene recurring across two cell classes, so the reproducible signal is limited to this marker rather than a broad pathway-level program; the 151 module is inferred from a short FDR gene list.

cell_types: 054 CNU-MGE GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Ctnna3 did not phenocopy related cadherin-catenin perturbations: across 22 shared neuronal classes, its Perturb-seq signatures were essentially uncorrelated with Cdh2, Ctnnb1, and the paralog Ctnna2, despite Cdh2 and Ctnnb1 achieving target knockdown in overlapping classes including 054 CNU-MGE GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 308 CB GABA. This argues against treating alpha-T-catenin, N-cadherin, and beta-catenin as interchangeable transcriptional perturbations in this cadherin-catenin adherens-junction context, although interpretation is limited because Ctnna3 itself showed little or no detectable target engagement.

Csrnp3 loss perturbation in this mouse brain Perturb-seq dataset did not reproduce the apoptosis/transactivation biology reported for CSRNP3/TAIP2 overexpression assays. Across all 22 assayed cell classes, Csrnp3 showed weak on-target mRNA engagement, no FDR-significant downstream genes, no recurrent same-direction gene module, no paralog transcript compensation within the CSRNP family, and no strong signature neighbors. Consistent with this, CSRNP-family DNA-binding transcriptional regulation appeared buffered, and positive regulation of apoptotic process was not detectably activated or repressed, though this comparison is limited because the literature used overexpression whereas this dataset tested loss perturbation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba
full_finding_text: Hspa9 perturbation produced a partial mitochondrial unfolded-protein-response/ISR-like signature rather than a canonical chaperone UPRmt. In the strongest responding neuronal populations—151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 052 Pvalb Gaba—Atf5 and Lonp1 were induced, while Hspd1, Hspe1, Clpp, and Hspa9 itself were not significantly increased. Stress and amino-acid-response genes recurred across these Hspa9-responsive cells. Because single-cell RNA may miss protein-level chaperone regulation, and guide targeting could obscure target-locus induction, the absence of transcript induction should be interpreted cautiously.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Slc1a2 knockdown in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut produced on-target depletion without detectable induction of Slc1a1, Slc1a3, Aqp4, Gfap, or Aldh1l1. Across these neuronal contexts, the SLC-mediated amino-acid transport and astrocytic glutamate-glutamine uptake programs showed no reproducible secondary module, and even permissive thresholds did not reveal consistent non-target responses. This argues against a neuron-autonomous compensatory rescue program in the profiled cells, while remaining limited by low or dropout-prone expression of these markers in neurons and therefore not excluding astrocyte compensation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Dnajc13 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a transcriptional response that was largely uncoupled from related endosomal trafficking perturbations: its Wilcoxon mRNA signature was near-orthogonal to Vps35, Rab7, Cltc, Washc4, Hspa8, and Atp13a2, with correlations between about -0.058 and 0.038. In this cell type, Dnajc13 had the only FDR-significant self-knockdown and no non-target FDR hits, whereas Vps35 and Rab7 produced much larger corrected signatures. These results reflect steady-state mRNA scores, not direct measurements of trafficking, cargo recycling, or endosomal morphology.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Nrf1 perturbation elicited a recurrent transcriptomic module across several neuronal classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. The shared pattern featured down-regulation of Cdc7, Kifc2, Snhg11, Rsrp1, Nrsn2, Haghl, Tia1, Sdha, Snrpn, and Zkscan16, with up-regulation of Pigp, Itfg2, and Msra; the largest response was in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. This recurrent set is a candidate marker of Nrf1-state induction, although the transcriptomic data alone do not establish direct NRF1 binding or distinguish primary from secondary regulation.

Cyfip2 perturbation did not show detected transcriptomic convergence with assayed related perturbations, including Cyfip1, Fmr1, Rac1, and Eif4e, and Cyfip1 was nearly orthogonal to Cyfip2 across matched cell classes. In the strongest Cyfip2-engaged classes—151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 155 MB Glut—Cyfip2 mRNA was reduced, but non-target genes and canonical WRC/BDNF transcripts were not FDR significant. These comparisons remain limited because most comparator rows did not pass FDR correction, several direct WRC subunits were not perturbed, and Cyfip1 target engagement was weak.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Kmt2a perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons produced a bidirectional 24-gene response rather than a simple loss of canonical KMT2A targets: downregulated genes included Nr2f1, Pcdh7, Lhx9, and Kmt2a, while upregulated genes included Igfbp5, Cfap74, Tnr, and Cx3cl1. In this mature neuronal cell type, HOX-family genes, Dlx2, Meis2, and Arc were not FDR-significant, suggesting a cell-type-specific regulon with mixed synaptic, adhesion, calcium, and glutamatergic features; because these canonical readouts may be lowly expressed here, the negative result reflects assay uncoupling rather than exclusion of regulation in other contexts.

Matr3 loss produced a recurrent transcriptional module across responsive classes, with Ddhd1, Atp9b, E2f4, Zkscan3, Kcnq2, Sugp2, Uggt2, and Rcor3 generally induced while Rsrp1 was repressed. A sharper Gpt2-positive branch was concentrated in midbrain and GABA-biased populations, including 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 054 CNU-MGE GABA, 053 Sst Gaba, and the strong thalamic 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut class. This core is a dataset-derived marker set rather than a curated MATR3 pathway, and enrichment was stronger in larger high-response gene lists than in the shared 10-gene core.

Ppara perturbation in all tested neuronal groups did not detectably engage the canonical PPARA:RXRA lipid-metabolism program: Acox1, Acot1, Acot2, Angptl4, Cpt1a, Cpt1c, Ehhadh, Hmgcs2, Pdk4, Acadm, Acadvl, and Plin2 were not shifted, and there was no strong Ppara self-depletion or FDR-supported downstream differential expression across the 22 neuronal groups. This suggests that the established fatty-acid-oxidation regulon was not engaged, or was buffered, in these unstimulated mouse neurons, with the caveat that much prior mechanistic support comes from hepatic or curated human pathway contexts.

Arnt perturbation did not produce a coherent canonical AHR/HIF transcriptional response in this basal assay: Vegfa showed only nominal, mixed-direction changes, while Tiparp, Slc2a1, Bnip3, Cyp1a1, Cyp1b1, and Ahrr were not FDR-significant, and Ahr/Ahrr signature correlations were near zero. This decoupling was seen without a strong cell-type-specific pattern, although 059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA showed the lowest adjusted p value, driven mainly by nominal Akap5 up-regulation and one nominal Vegfa decrease. Because there was no imposed hypoxic or xenobiotic stimulus and Arnt engagement appeared weak, these data do not show collapse of HIF1A-ARNT or AHR-ARNT programs and should not be taken to mean ARNT is dispensable.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Tomm40, in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cell type where on-target knockdown was strongest, showed a weak and idiosyncratic RNA signature: despite significant Tomm40 depletion across 224 perturbed cells, no non-target gene, mitochondrial protein import/TOM-complex module, or Alzheimer/cholesterol/amyloid panel survived FDR. Cross-perturbation correlations with App, Psen1, Snca, and Park7 were approximately zero, and the strongest screen-wide neighbors were only Macf1 (r=0.072) and Arih1 (r=-0.067). Because major TOM-complex partners were not perturbed, direct same-complex convergence could not be tested, and all comparisons are RNA based.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Clpp showed little detectable mitochondrial proteostasis stress transcription in this dataset: across assayed brain cell types, canonical mitochondrial unfolded protein response and integrated stress response genes such as Ddit3, Atf4, Atf5, Hspd1, Hspe1, Hspa9, Herpud1, Slc7a1, and Rtn3 were not significantly induced after Clpp perturbation, with only one corrected differential-expression hit overall. By contrast, Lonp1 produced stronger corrected stress-like responses, including Ddit3 and Rtn3 in 155 MB Glut and Herpud1, Ddit3, and Slc7a1 in 217 P MY Pineal Glut, although the comparison is limited by differing perturbed-cell counts and guide efficacy.

Nhs showed only weak signatures, and among available RAC/WAVE-Arp2/3 actin-remodeling neighbors, Cyfip2—but not Cyfip1 or Rac1—repeatedly displayed significant on-target depletion, with Cyfip2 self-knockdown detected in six subclasses. These neighbor perturbations were essentially uncorrelated with the weak Nhs transcriptomic pattern and did not phenocopy it, suggesting the Nhs null is target-specific rather than a generic property of actin/WAVE-adjacent guides in this dataset. A caveat is that direct NHS interactors such as Wasf and Brk1 were measured as transcripts but were not available as perturbation targets.

Dnm1 knockdown did not produce detectable transcriptional compensation by other dynamin or selected endocytic genes: across the measured Dnm1-perturbed cells, Dnm2, Dnm3, Bin1, and Synj1 showed no adjusted-significant mRNA induction, with reported minimum FDR values of 1.0. This suggests that any functional redundancy among dynamins in this assay is not explained by an acute mRNA up-regulation program. However, buffering of Dnm1 loss could still occur through protein relocalization, isoform switching, or pre-existing Dnm2/Dnm3 activity without changes in transcript abundance.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|308 CB GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|191 MB P MY GABA|217 P MY Pineal Glut
full_finding_text: Rnf13 showed weak, nonrecurrent transcriptomic coupling across engaged neuronal cell types, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 308 CB GABA, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut. Its signature was only modestly correlated with ER-stress genes Atf6 and Hspa5, JNK genes Mapk8 and Mapk9, AP-3/endolysosomal Ap3b2, and nearby RING-ligase perturbations such as Rnf216 and Rnf220, with no strong positive or negative neighbor overall. Because correlations were based on rank-score vectors and Rnf13 signatures were weak, these data do not support using acute scRNA-seq as a robust surrogate for RNF13-linked ER-stress, JNK, or AP-3 activity.

cell_types: 191 MB P MY GABA|046 CTX-CGE GABA
full_finding_text: Atp13a3 perturbation did not converge with Sms, the spermine-synthesis gene, in this mouse-brain assay: their matched-cell transcriptional signatures were near-zero correlated, so the data do not support a generic neuronal polyamine-depletion module or collapsing ATP13A3 transport with spermine synthesis into one transcriptomic effect. This was seen despite Atp13a3 RNA shifting in the depletion direction across all 22 cell classes, with no genome-wide significant Atp13a3 response after per-contrast correction. In 191 MB P MY GABA, the one cell type with an FDR-significant Sms target row, Sms still did not define an Atp13a3-like signature; weak Sms target engagement in most contrasts leaves open buffering versus insufficient knockdown.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Grm1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a buffered transcriptomic response: the perturbation yielded only an FDR-significant reduction of Grm1 itself, whereas ionotropic NMDAR perturbations in the same thalamic class were less buffered, with Grin1 producing 89 FDR-significant genes and Grin2b producing 2. Although Grin2b was the strongest glutamate-receptor neighbor of Grm1, the restricted-signature similarity was still weak (r=0.195), indicating that chronic mGluR1 and NMDAR loss-of-function outputs are not interchangeable despite their shared postsynaptic glutamate-receptor signaling context.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA
full_finding_text: Tnpo3 perturbation produced a recurrent down-regulation of an RNA-processing, SR-factor, and nuclear-speckle module across multiple neuronal classes, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, and 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA. Decreased transcripts repeatedly included Srrm2, Srsf1, Srsf2, Srsf5, Srsf7, Akap8l, and Tcea2, with the largest response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. This pattern is consistent with the TNPO3 cargo-import pathway rather than a generic stress response, although the experiment measured transcript abundance rather than SR-protein nuclear localization or exon-level splicing.

Folr1 perturbation did not produce a detectable folate transport or one-carbon transcriptional response in the profiled neurons: 21 measured genes in this pathway, including Slc19a1, Slc46a1, Dhfr, Mthfr, Mthfd1/1l/2/2l, Shmt1/2, Mtr, Mtrr, Tyms, Folr2, Lrp2, Tfrc, Cubn, Folh1, Fpgs, and Ggh, remained unchanged, with only a weak nominal signal for Mthfd1 that did not survive adjustment. This argues against interpreting the weak Folr1 signature as a folate-homeostasis program, while noting that the perturbation itself was weak and a transcript panel may miss altered metabolite flux.

Lingo2 perturbation did not produce detectable transcriptional feedback in the LINGO/NgR/TFF3-associated receptor axis: Lingo1, Rtn4r, Ngfr, Adam10, Egfr, Tnfrsf19, Rtn4, Omg, and the sparsely detected Tff3 were unchanged in Lingo2 profiles. This lack of response was seen across profiled glutamatergic cell types and in Sst GABA cells, where the axis appeared buffered despite only nominal Sst/Opcml upshift. The result suggests that any LINGO-related compensation here was not exposed at the mRNA level, and cannot address surface complex formation, ADAM10 cleavage, ligand binding, RhoA activity, or EGFR phosphorylation.

cell_types: 308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Cep290 showed no stable high-correlation biological neighbor across the panel, but in 308 CB GABA cells there was an exploratory same-direction overlap with B9d1, a ciliary transition-zone neighbor in the MKS complex. B9d1 was the top positive Cep290 signature neighbor in this cell type and had nine FDR-significant genes, with weak nominal overlap in genes including Bend6, Gas8, Arhgap31, Col5a1, Slc20a1, Phc2, Homer3, Doc2b, and Arl15. However, Cep290 itself did not reach FDR on the overlapping genes, neither perturbation showed RNA-level self-depletion, and similar cerebellar correlations also involved safe-target guides, so this putative CB GABA ciliary-neighbor module remains hypothesis-generating rather than confirmed.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Ctcf loss reduced clustered protocadherin transcripts in the two broad glutamatergic responses, most prominently in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and also in 155 MB Glut. In these cell types, many Pcdh alpha, beta, and gamma genes were downregulated, including Pcdhb20, Pcdhb17, Pcdhb16, Pcdhac1, Pcdha10, Pcdhb18, Pcdhgb2, and Pcdhga12, consistent with a suppressed clustered protocadherin cell-cell adhesion program. The dataset measures transcript-level differential expression only, so it does not directly test chromatin looping or single-cell stochastic promoter choice.

cell_types: 191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Klf1 perturbation in 191 MB P MY GABA cells showed a hypothesis-generating nominal down-tail, where Map1a, Pkm, Aldoc, and Got1 were among the most negative genes, alongside Mdh1, Slc25a12, Actg1, Tuba1b, and Thy1. The top 20 nominally down-regulated genes were enriched for putative energy-metabolism and neuronal cytoskeletal or myelin-related annotations, making this the most interpretable Klf1 signal in the dataset. However, this pattern is exploratory because the best adjusted p value for the cell type was 0.2285.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Sin3a showed a reproducible signature convergence with Max, but not with Myc or Mycn, across major responder cell types including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, 052 Pvalb Gaba, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 191 MB P MY GABA. In these neurons, Max ranked among the closest positive Sin3a signature neighbors, whereas Myc and Mycn were nearly uncorrelated, consistent with a SIN3A-HDAC/MAX-linked repressor program rather than Myc-family activation. However, the correlations were modest and come from restricted transcriptomic signature comparisons rather than biochemical evidence in the assayed cells.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut
full_finding_text: Ogt showed convergent positive restricted-signature correlations with nuclear transport and nuclear pore/export perturbations, especially in strong responder neuronal populations including 155 MB Glut, 191 MB P MY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, and 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut. Across these classes, Xpo1, Tpr, Ranbp2, and Tnpo3 were recurrent top neighbors; in 155 MB Glut, for example, correlations reached Ranbp2 r=0.678, Tpr r=0.645, Tnpo3 r=0.536, and Xpo1 r=0.432. These exploratory comparisons, based on each cell type’s top 200 Ogt-responsive genes, link the adult neuronal Ogt program to a nucleocytoplasmic transport/RNA-processing axis rather than a single canonical signaling cascade.

Tspan7 produced a transcriptional signature that was essentially uncorrelated with Cd81, Tspan12, Gria2, Itgb1, Fmr1, Mecp2, Pten, and Syngap1 perturbations in this dataset, indicating that related tetraspanin, AMPAR-interactor, integrin, and neurodevelopmental disease perturbations did not phenocopy Tspan7 at the signature level. This argues against treating Tspan7 knockdown as a generic proxy for these pathways or disease-linked states. A caveat is that several comparator perturbations showed weak self-transcript knockdown, so the negative similarity is strongest for the well-engaged Cd81 comparison.

Nr2e1 perturbation did not recover the canonical TLX neural-stem-cell program in the profiled neuronal classes: no downstream gene reached multiple-testing-corrected significance, and expected TLX-HDAC pathway genes Pten, Cdkn1a, Gfap, Ccnd1, Ccnd2, Wnt7a, Wnt7b, Sirt1, and Hes1 all remained unchanged (FDR=1.0). This negative readout suggests these neuronal classes may be the wrong context for the developmental or retinal TLX module, while also leaving open the caveat that some expected targets may be silent or poorly measured, so lack of RNA response does not exclude Nr2e1 functions in progenitor or stem-cell settings.

Irf2bpl showed a distinct profile: perturbations of the IRF2BP-family transcriptional-regulator neighborhood, including Irf2, Irf1, Irf7, Sin3a, and Hdac4, had only weak or absent convergence with the Irf2bpl signature rather than closely phenocopying it. After Irf2bpl perturbation, Irf2bp1 and Irf2bp2 mRNA levels were not detectably changed, arguing against obvious paralog compensation in this dataset. A caveat is that Irf2bp1 and Irf2bp2 were not directly perturbed here, and network proximity does not imply the same biochemical complex in the assayed mouse cells.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Zfp961 showed a weak, selective phenotype in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons: despite 161 perturbed cells, its signature was largely uncoupled from the strong chromatin-perturbation signatures seen for Setdb1 and Chd4 in the same dataset, with no strong positive or negative perturbation neighbors. This suggests the weak Zfp961 result is not due to a general inability to detect chromatin-factor biology, but rather that Zfp961 is narrow, weakly engaged, or silent in these neuronal states. The comparison is qualified because Trim28/Kap1 was not perturbed, and Chd4 is not specific to KRAB repression.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Gigyf2 perturbation in the main responsive glutamatergic populations, especially 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, produced a downstream RNA-processing/Xbp1-like state marked by Xbp1, Rsrp1, Luc7l2, Snrnp70, and Sf3b4, with midbrain glutamatergic cells also showing a downregulated synaptic-gene tail. In contrast, transcripts for known GIGYF2 partners or related surveillance factors, including Eif4e2, Zfp598, Ddx6, Tnrc6a, and ASCC/RQC genes, were not detectably induced, suggesting no simple transcriptional compensation; however, this does not address partner recruitment or protein-level regulation.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Dst was largely orthogonal to related cytoskeletal perturbation signatures in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut cells: score correlations with Macf1, Plec, Map1b, Dync1h1, Tubb3, and Kif5c were near zero, with no robust positive or inverse Dst neighbor. In 155 MB Glut, Macf1, Map1b, Dync1h1, and Tubb3 showed clear self-transcript depletion, whereas Dst did not, and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut likewise showed no Dst mRNA depletion despite the largest Dst-perturbed cell count. Because the Dst score vectors were weak, this mainly indicates absence of co-signature rather than true antagonism, consistent with a Dst-specific engagement, isoform, or sampled-cell-context limitation.

Gp6 showed a weak, FDR-silent perturbation profile, and related platelet or microglial receptor perturbations—Fyn, Itga2, Itgb1, Gp1ba, Mpl, P2ry12, Trem2, and Fcgr2b—were likewise FDR-silent across the same 21 cell types and were not strong positive or negative neighbors of the Gp6 differential-expression signature. In 308 CB GABA, only nominal Mphosph8 and Sumo1 outliers and the largest weak signature-neighbor correlations were seen, supporting at most an exploratory signal. This pattern argues against a missed collagen-receptor module, although core GPVI effectors such as Fcer1g, Lyn, Syk, Lat, Lcp2, and Plcg2 were not independently perturbed in this library.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Nr1d1 perturbation showed its clearest FDR-controlled response in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut thalamic class, where the transcriptomic effect was mixed but predominantly up and extended beyond core clock genes to a synapse and neuronal-projection module. Prominent responsive genes included Erc2, Cacna2d3, Slc8a1, Adcy1, Ppp3ca, Camk4, Shank2, Grik4, Rims4, Nfasc, Cntnap1, Ank2, L1cam, and Timp3, with enrichment for synapse, cell-junction, and neuron-projection terms. This module is inferred from gene identities and annotations; electrophysiology, morphology, and circadian phase were not measured.

Tpm3 perturbation showed a weak, transcriptionally buffered signature that was near-uncorrelated with Tpm1 and did not reproduce the actin-subunit compensation module seen after Actb targeting. Across Tpm3 tests, even the strongest nominal single-gene responses failed multiple-testing correction, and in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut a high-count Tpm3 bin still lacked a corrected Tpm3 response, whereas the same class showed strong Actb-driven Actg1 and Flna up-regulation. Similarly, in 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut, Actb strongly induced Flna and Actg1, contrasting with the null Tpm3 response. A caveat is that on-target Tpm3 and Actb mRNAs were not measured.

cell_types: 001 L5-6 IT Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|053 Sst Gaba|054 CNU-MGE GABA|059 CNU-LGE LSX GABA|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA|215 MB Dopa|217 P MY Pineal Glut|308 CB GABA
full_finding_text: Hlcs perturbation did not produce coherent mRNA feedback in the biotin transport and biotin-dependent carboxylase activation pathway across the sampled neuronal and glial cell types, including multiple glutamatergic and GABAergic populations. Transcripts for Pcca, Pccb, Acaca, Mccc1, Mccc2, Btd, and Slc5a6 were all non-significant, with best FDR values of 1.0, arguing against a strong adult-neuronal transcriptional compensation response at this perturbation strength. A caveat is that pyruvate carboxylase was not measured in the extracted Hlcs table, and neither enzyme activity nor protein biotinylation was assayed.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Calm3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c glutamatergic cells showed strong target knockdown but no FDR-significant non-target transcriptional program, whereas the comparator Calm1, despite matched target depletion and an identical calmodulin protein sequence, induced a broader signature including Rasgrp2, Peg3, Aifm3, Tuba1b, Resp18, and Atp2b1; the Calm1-versus-Calm3 signature correlation was near zero. This divergence suggests transcript-level non-interchangeability in this cell type, but because separate guide sets and cell captures were compared, it does not establish isoform-specific calmodulin protein activity.

Rab27a showed no detectable convergent transcriptional module in this screen: a restricted neighbor scan found no strong positive or negative Rab27a correlate, with the largest absolute correlation only 0.187. Available comparators, including Myo5a, Rab7, Rab3gap1, Rab3gap2, Rab18, and Rab28, were similarly poorly correlated with Rab27a, and most direct RAB27A paralogs or effectors such as Rab27b, Mlph, Sytl4, Myrip, Exph5, and Unc13d were not perturbed. This weak, nonconvergent pattern persisted across subclasses, including 017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut and 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, despite detectable Rab7 and Myo5a target engagement in the same dataset.

Ncam1 knockdown showed canonical NCAM1–FGFR/Fyn neurite-outgrowth signaling to be transcriptionally uncoupled in this assay: after excluding the directly targeted Ncam1 transcript, there were no FDR-significant trans effects, and Fgfr1, Fyn, L1cam, Nrcam, and Chl1 were not FDR-regulated in Ncam1 contrasts. Cross-perturbation checks were similarly weak, as Fgfr1 or Fyn perturbations did not produce broad FDR-level programs. These results suggest the pathway may be buffered, post-translational, or outside the sampled response window, with the caveat that Fyn perturbation lacked clear Fyn mRNA knockdown and MAPK/CREB activity was not measured directly.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut
full_finding_text: Chrna3 showed no clear alpha3 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor complex convergence in restricted-signature analyses. Using only the top 300 Chrna3 z-score genes, correlations were weak or anti-correlated with Chrnb2, Chrnb4, Chrna4, and Chrna1 in the strongest contexts, including 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut. In 009, the nominal Chrna3 signal was driven by a single Sybu increase and was anti-correlated with Chrna1, while in 151 Chrna3 remained FDR-negative even as Chrnb2, Chrna4, and Ache showed detectable on-target effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut
full_finding_text: Zbtb18-associated co-repressor perturbations did not phenocopy the Zbtb18 transcriptional program. In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, Ctbp1 produced its own FDR-significant program but did not induce the Zbtb18-linked thalamic markers Pxdn, Clstn2, or Man2a2, while Dnmt3a yielded no FDR-significant genes there or in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, where Zbtb18 had induced Pxdn. Thus, broad co-repressor modulation was divergent from Zbtb18 rather than a transcriptomic proxy, although Ctbp2 and several NuRD/HDAC components were not tested and the DNMT3A-RP58 link is largely biochemical rather than adult-neuronal.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut
full_finding_text: Zbtb18 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut cells showed only a restricted overlap with Zbtb7a: both perturbations FDR-induced Pxdn, Clstn2, and Man2a2 within an adult thalamic Zbtb18 effector module, whereas Zbtb7a did not induce Endou and instead drove a much larger 841-gene program. This convergence-with-divergence was limited to one cell type and three shared genes, and whole-transcriptome similarity between Zbtb18 and Zbtb7a was weak (r=0.045), arguing against interchangeability despite the shared BTB-zinc-finger-sensitive output subset.

Upf3b perturbation showed a very sparse gene-level response rather than a broad EJC-linked nonsense-mediated decay program: only Inpp5f reached FDR significance, while canonical NMD-factor transcripts including Upf1, Upf2, Upf3a, Smg1, Smg5, Smg6, and Smg7 were not significantly regulated. Upf3b mRNA itself was measured across analyzed cell classes but was not significantly depleted and showed inconsistent direction, so the data are more consistent with weak measured engagement, branch-selective NMD inhibition, or buffering than with a strong global NMD collapse; isoform-specific NMD effects could also be missed by gene-level differential expression.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Kcnab2 showed near-zero transcriptome correlation with Kcnab1, Kcna1, and Kcna2 perturbations across the five engaged Kcnab2 cell types—052 Pvalb Gaba, 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA—despite the known Kvβ/Kv1 physical relationship. In these classes, Kcnab2 was down with a target-only response, no compensatory Kv1/Shaker family RNA changes, and no strongly convergent or anti-correlated neighbors. However, this remains exploratory because Kcnab1, Kcna1, and Kcna2 lacked significant self-knockdown here, and the published Kcnab2–Kcna2 phenocopy was reported in adult dopamine neurons rather than these scored cell classes.

Ephb1 showed weak transcript-level target engagement in this screen: direct measurement found no multiple-testing-significant on-target Ephb1 mRNA depletion, and in matched classes Ephb2 and Ephb4 were similarly weak, with Ephb1 yielding only a single Tmem135 hit. By contrast, Epha4 was reproducibly and strongly depleted in five glutamatergic classes, indicating that the Ephb1 negative result was target specific rather than a generic inability to detect Eph receptors. This comparison reflects guide-level transcript depletion, not equal protein knockdown or ligand context, and Ephb3 and ephrin ligands were not perturbed here.

Pax2 was transcriptionally inert in this adult neuronal assay, and the broader PAX2-associated developmental interaction neighborhood was similarly quiet: perturbations of En1, Lmx1b, Otx2, Six1, and Wt1 were all FDR-null, with no FDR<0.05 genes across 112 signatures. Pax2 also lacked high-correlation positive or negative transcriptomic neighbors, and its global differential-expression output showed no conventionally significant downstream response. This pattern suggests the assay is uncoupled from an embryonic PAX2 developmental network, although the null could reflect lack of expression or target engagement and some interaction links derive from heterogeneous human evidence.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|145 MH-LH TH Glut|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Deaf1 perturbation produced a compact, recurrent downregulated module centered on Eif4g3, Rac3, B4gat1, and Tmem80 rather than a broad transcriptome-wide response. This signal recurred across 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut, 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, with the strongest effects in thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c and midbrain glutamatergic neurons; the GABAergic midbrain/pons/medulla class shared the same module with Rac3 significant and the others nominal. The module is transcriptomic only, and Deaf1 itself never reached self-knockdown FDR<0.05, so the observed program may underestimate or bias direct loss-of-function effects.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Deaf1 perturbation showed a target-specific four-gene module, as perturbing selected predicted or serotonin-related DEAF1 neighbors—Cc2d1a, Htr1a, Htr2c, Zmynd11, and Crebbp—did not reproduce the Eif4g3/B4gat1/Rac3/Tmem80 pattern in the two strongest Deaf1-responsive cell types, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut. In 155 MB Glut, the recurrent down-module included Tmem80, and overall the comparison was nonconvergent, though this was a restricted four-marker test and several comparator perturbations had weak or variable self-transcript engagement.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|009 L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut|017 CA3 CA2-FC DG Glut|022 L5 ET CTX Glut|046 CTX-CGE GABA|052 Pvalb Gaba|066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Dock3 showed transcriptomic signatures that were essentially uncorrelated with perturbations of Rac1 and related Rac/Rho/DOCK GEF-axis genes, including Trio, Dock7, Kalrn, Ntrk2, Fyn, Gsk3b, and Grin2b, across matched cell types such as L4-5 IT CTX Glut, L2-3 IT PIR AON ENT Glut, CA3/CA2-FC/DG Glut, L5 ET CTX Glut, CTX-CGE GABA, Pvalb Gaba, CNU-HYa HY GABA, TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, MB Glut, and MB P MY GABA. Even where Trio showed clear self-depletion, Dock3–Trio correlations remained only 0.014–0.040. Rac1 and Dock7 knockdown was weak in the matched contexts, so the negative comparison is strongest for Trio, and the result suggests Dock3 loss should not be read as a generic Rac1-pathway mRNA signature.

Ttc21b perturbation did not recapitulate a canonical Hedgehog/Smoothened transcriptional response in the assayed neuronal contexts: Gli1, Gli2, Gli3, Ptch1, Ptch2, Hhip, Shh, and Smo were not detectably shifted, with all Ttc21b contrasts showing no multiple-testing-corrected signal, and genome-wide summaries likewise showing no robust downstream response in any assayed cell type. Given sparse Hedgehog readout expression in many mature neuronal classes and weak Ttc21b target-transcript engagement, this is best interpreted as a weak or absent transcriptomic phenotype here, not proof that Ttc21b is uncoupled from Hedgehog biology.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut|008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Bptf showed a sparse, Gaa-centered response in upper-layer cortical glutamatergic neurons rather than a scaled-down version of the thalamic program: in 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut and 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut, only two FDR-significant genes were detected in each class, both including Gaa repression, with Fscn1 significant in 005 and Itpa in 008, instead of the broader Zcwpw2/Resp18/Abhd14b module seen most strongly in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut. A 155 MB Glut class shared part of the core response but with a smaller significant gene set, and the cortical result is limited by the very restricted signatures.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba|191 MB P MY GABA
full_finding_text: Tia1 showed weak, largely distinct transcriptional effects rather than phenocopying disease-linked stress-granule or RNA-binding protein perturbations. In 052 Pvalb Gaba and 191 MB P MY GABA, Tia1 produced only one isolated FDR hit in each class, with Dpm1 or Zyg11b up and no detectable Tia1 transcript reduction, whereas Tardbp and Fus generated many more same-cell-type FDR responses. Across eight available comparators—Fus, Tardbp, Atxn2, Fmr1, Hnrnpa1, Hnrnpa2b1, Pum1, and Ddx3x—Tia1 score-vector correlations were near zero, though this contrast is limited by the weak Tia1 perturbation, unavailable Tial1/G3bp1/G3bp2 perturbations, and reliance on restricted mRNA-abundance signatures.

cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA|151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut|155 MB Glut
full_finding_text: Epha2 showed no significant downstream transcriptional changes after perturbation, and its own transcript did not shift by Wilcoxon rank in any measured stratum, indicating that the Epha2 null was not simply a universal failure to respond to nearby PI3K/MAPK signaling perturbations.
